articles.title: PHYRD: A Living Benchmark for Reproducing and Extending Theoretical Physics Research
articles.abstract: Large language models and agents have shown significant power in advanced physical research. In this paper, We introduce PHYRD, a living benchmark for theoretical-physics reasoning with 63 Reproduce and 43 Discover problems. Reproduce tests derivation of published results; Discover tests consequences of modified theoretical conditions. FormulaForest constructs the tasks with reference solutions and subquestion-level rubrics. Across five models, whole-problem accuracy ranges from 49.21% to 68.25% on Reproduce and from 18.60% to 74.42% on closed-book Discover. With tools, four models complete more Discover problems, but conceptual errors and missing arguments persist. Besides, our experimental results demonstrate the value of FormulaForest as synthetic data. On FrontierScience, a benchmark developed by OpenAI, it raises the accuracy of a Qwen-35B-A3B model from 61% to 72%.
articles.titleCn: PHYRD：一个用于复制和扩展理论物理研究的动态基准
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型和智能体在高级物理研究中展现出显著的能力。在本文中，我们介绍了PHYRD，一个用于理论物理推理的动态基准，包含63个可复现问题和43个发现性问题。可复现问题测试已发表结果的推导过程；发现性问题测试理论条件修改后的推论。FormulaForest构建了包含参考答案和子问题级别评分标准的任务。在五个模型上，可复现问题的整体问题准确率介于49.21%至68.25%，闭卷发现性问题的整体问题准确率介于18.60%至74.42%。借助工具，四个模型完成了更多发现性问题，但概念性错误和缺失论据问题仍然存在。此外，我们的实验结果表明FormulaForest作为合成数据的价值。在OpenAI开发的基准测试FrontierScience上，它将Qwen-35B-A3B模型的准确率从61%提升至72%。

articles.title: Pseudo-Labels as Rewards, Not Targets: Group-Relative Policy Optimization for Semi-Supervised ASR
articles.abstract: Adapting ASR to a domain with only untranscribed audio typically relies on pseudo-labeling, a strong teacher transcribes the audio and a student is fine-tuned on it. Because supervised fine-tuning (SFT) treats every pseudo-label token as a target, the student inherits the teacher's errors. We show that using the same pseudo-labels as a reward reference for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is more robust to label noise. In the banking domain, GRPO yields 29.3% to 56.2% relative WER improvements over SFT on Whisper-generated labels, and the advantage holds across four Whisper sizes, four teacher families, three domains and four languages. While SFT reproduces almost 100% of teacher errors verbatim, GRPO passes through only 27%. Rollout statistics explain why, erroneous pseudo-label words rarely appear in on-policy rollouts, so group-relative advantages stay aligned with the clean transcript, whereas SFT forces them into the policy's support and collapses the reward variance GRPO relies on.
articles.titleCn: 伪标签作为奖励而非目标：用于半监督语音识别的相对策略优化
articles.abstractCn: 针对仅包含未转录音频的领域，语音识别（ASR）的适配通常依赖于伪标签技术，即由一位强大的教师转录音频，然后对另一位学生进行微调。由于监督微调（SFT）将每个伪标签视为目标，学生会继承教师的错误。我们表明，将相同的伪标签用作群体相对策略优化（GRPO）的奖励参考比SFT更鲁棒，更能抵抗标签噪声。在银行领域，与Whisper生成的标签相比，GRPO在SFT的基础上实现了29.3%至56.2%的相对词错误率（WER）改进，且这种优势在四种Whisper大小、四种教师家族、三个领域和四种语言中均保持一致。尽管SFT几乎逐字复制了教师的错误，但GRPO仅传递了27%。运行统计可以解释原因：错误的伪标签词很少出现在策略运行中，因此群体相对优势与干净文本保持一致，而SFT则迫使这些优势进入策略的支持范围，并压缩了GRPO所依赖的奖励方差。

articles.title: Principled Nonlinear Concept Erasure and Steering
articles.abstract: Learned representations often encode sensitive attributes, such as gender or race, that may be undesirable or unsafe to retain. Concept erasure aims to remove this information while preserving task-relevant content. Existing methods remain incomplete: linear methods provide guarantees only against linear probes, while nonlinear methods achieve stronger empirical erasure but lack formal guarantees and often sacrifice utility. In this work, we introduce a principled conditional autoencoder framework for nonlinear concept erasure. We follow the principle that erasure should remove only the sensitive attribute and nothing else, and we show that, under the stated assumptions, perfect reconstruction together with population-level independence is sufficient for perfect nonlinear guardedness, with preservation guarantees in the imperfect-reconstruction regime. Empirically, we attain a superior utility-erasure trade-off across multiple datasets, sensitive attributes, and language models, surpassing even the supervised variants of competing methods despite using no target-task labels, while being simpler to optimize and converging substantially faster. Beyond erasure, our framework yields concept conversion (representation steering) as a by-product: by changing only the target concept at inference time, it produces representations corresponding to different concept values - at no additional training cost - a capability no prior erasure method provides, and on which we likewise demonstrate strong empirical performance.
articles.titleCn: 基于原则的非线性概念擦除与引导
articles.abstractCn: 学习到的表征常常编码敏感属性，如性别或种族，这些属性可能是不希望保留或存在安全隐患的。概念擦除旨在移除这些信息，同时保留与任务相关的有用内容。现有方法仍存在不足：线性方法仅能提供针对线性探测的保证，而非线性方法虽然能实现更强的经验擦除效果，但缺乏形式化保证，且常常牺牲效用。在本工作中，我们引入了一种基于原则的条件自动编码器框架，用于非线性概念擦除。我们遵循擦除应仅移除敏感属性而不影响其他内容的指导原则，并证明，在所提出的假设下，完美重建与群体级独立性足以实现完美的非线性保护，并在非完美重建情况下提供保证。经验上，我们在多个数据集、敏感属性和语言模型上实现了优越的效用-擦除权衡，即使不使用目标任务标签，其性能也超越了竞争方法的监督变体，同时优化更简单，收敛速度也显著更快。除了擦除之外，我们的框架还产生了概念转换（表征引导）作为副产品：通过仅在推理时改变目标概念，它能够生成对应不同概念值的表征——无需额外训练成本——这一能力是先前擦除方法所不具备的，并且我们在该能力上也展示了强大的经验性能。

articles.title: Analysing Austrian Parliamentary Speeches by Predicting Party Affiliations
articles.abstract: This paper examines speech characteristics of the Austrian National Council members (CMs). We introduce analysis methodology based on a fine-tuned BERT-Model which assigns to every speech a probability distribution over Austrian parties. These are then aggregated at the speaker and party level. We perform an extensive evaluation to ensure the quality of the generated distributions prior to further analysis. Instead of considering mis-assignments of predicted parties as a performance issue, we leverage them to derive insights about the CMs and political developments. Our findings show that parties that govern together become more similar in their speech characteristics, while, analogously, parties that are in opposition move further away from governing parties. Moreover, CMs who switch party usually adapt their speech characteristics only after the switch occurs. Finally, we publicly release a data set containing party affiliation predictions for the speeches of the Austrian National Council from 1996 to 2018.
articles.titleCn: 通过预测政党归属来分析奥地利议会演讲
articles.abstractCn: 本文研究了奥地利国民议会成员（CM）的演讲特征。我们引入了一种基于微调BERT模型的分析方法，该方法为每篇演讲分配一个覆盖奥地利各政党的概率分布，并在发言人层面和政党层面进行聚合。我们在进一步分析之前对生成的分布进行了广泛的评估，以确保其质量。我们没有将预测政党的错误分配视为性能问题，而是利用它们来推导出关于CM和政治发展的见解。我们的研究结果表明，共同执政的政党在演讲特征上变得更加相似，而类似地，在野党则与执政党疏远。此外，更换政党的CM通常只在更换发生后才会调整其演讲特征。最后，我们公开发布了一个数据集，其中包含1996年至2018年奥地利国民议会演讲的政党归属预测。

articles.title: The Punjabi Geet Toxicity Dataset (PGT-FG): Fine-Grained Multimodal Annotations for Toxic Content in Punjabi Songs
articles.abstract: Resources for toxicity detection in Punjabi remain limited, particularly for musical content that combines linguistic and multimodal information. We present the Punjabi Geet Toxicity Dataset (PGT-FG), a segment-level resource developed to support research on toxicity detection in Punjabi musical content. The dataset was constructed from publicly available Punjabi songs collected from YouTube. An initial collection of 620 songs resulted in 465 successfully downloaded songs and 3,402 preliminary segments from 450 songs. After quality control and annotation, the final dataset contains 2,396 unique segments from 392 songs. Four native Punjabi annotators produced 2,870 annotation records, including a shared subset of 158 segments annotated by all four. Each annotation includes binary toxicity, eight fine-grained toxicity categories, severity, sentiment, mode, and an uncertainty flag. Inter-annotator agreement was measured with Fleiss' kappa on the shared subset, and majority-based resolution produced the final segment-level labels. Of the 2,396 segments, 705 (29.42%) were labelled toxic and 1,691 (70.58%) non-toxic. Violence was the most frequent category, occurring in 539 toxic segments (76.45%), followed by gang references (227, 32.20%) and drug references (133, 18.87%). The overall toxicity label achieved substantial agreement (kappa = 0.6521). PGT-FG provides a fine-grained resource for Punjabi toxicity detection and multimodal content analysis. The resolved dataset, with one final record per segment, is publicly available on Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23040156). Original lyrics, lyric excerpts, and copyrighted audio or video content are not redistributed.
articles.titleCn: 旁遮普语歌曲中的毒性内容细粒度多模态标注数据集（PGT-FG）
articles.abstractCn: 旁遮普语毒性检测的资源仍然有限，尤其是在结合语言和多模态信息的音乐内容方面。我们提出了旁遮普语歌曲毒性数据集（PGT-FG），这是一个片段级别的资源，旨在支持旁遮普语音乐内容毒性检测的研究。该数据集由从YouTube上公开可用的旁遮普语歌曲中收集的数据构建而成。最初收集的620首歌曲产生了465首成功下载的歌曲和来自450首歌曲的3402个初步片段。经过质量控制和标注后，最终数据集包含来自392首歌曲的2396个唯一片段。四位母语旁遮普语标注员产生了2870条标注记录，其中包括由四位标注员共同标注的158个片段子集。每条标注包括二元毒性、八个细粒度毒性类别、严重程度、情感、模式和一个不确定性标志。标注者间的一致性通过与共享子集上的Fleiss' kappa进行测量，基于多数决议的最终片段级别标签得以确定。在2396个片段中，705个（29.42%）被标记为有毒，1691个（70.58%）被标记为无毒。暴力是最频繁的类别，出现在539个有毒片段（76.45%）中，其次是帮派参考（227个，32.20%）和毒品参考（133个，18.87%）。整体毒性标签达到了高度一致性（kappa = 0.6521）。PGT-FG为旁遮普语毒性检测和多模态内容分析提供了一个细粒度资源。该已解决的数据集，每个片段一条最终记录，已在Zenodo上公开发布（https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23040156）。原始歌词、歌词摘录以及受版权保护的音频或视频内容不会被重新分发。

articles.title: Accordion: Elastic-Depth Inference via Fixed-Prefix Layer Looping
articles.abstract: Large language models serve applications with diverse inference budgets, but training and maintaining separate models for each budget incurs substantial costs. Recent Looped Transformers enable flexible inference computation through parameter reuse, but maintaining strong performance across different inference budgets remains an open challenge. We introduce Accordion, a mixture-of-experts-based model that supports five inference budgets through fixed-prefix layer looping. Each budget follows a pre-defined execution path, while the minimum budget retains the unlooped model. Joint pretraining samples one budget per micro-batch and optimizes its next-token prediction loss without additional cross-budget consistency objectives. We further preserve these inference budgets through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, where parameter-group merging and budget-matched multi-teacher on-policy distillation integrate three domain experts into one model. After 3.6T tokens of pretraining, increasing inference depth improves Accordion-6B-A0.5B's five-category macro-average across 37 tasks by 3.01 percentage points, with the middle budget capturing 89% of this gain using half as many additional layer executions. The final model surpasses each domain expert on its corresponding task-and-budget average, while achieving strong instruction-following performance across all budgets and retaining depth-dependent gains in mathematical reasoning and code generation.
articles.titleCn: 手风琴：通过固定前缀层循环实现弹性深度推理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型服务于具有不同推理预算的应用，但为每个预算训练和维护单独的模型会带来巨大的成本。最近的循环Transformer通过参数重用来实现灵活的推理计算，但在不同推理预算下保持高性能仍然是一个开放性挑战。我们介绍了Accordion，这是一种基于专家混合的模型，通过固定前缀层循环支持五种推理预算。每个预算遵循预定义的执行路径，而最低预算保留未循环的模型。联合预训练每个微批次选择一个预算，并优化其下一个词预测损失，而无需额外的跨预算一致性目标。我们进一步通过监督微调和强化学习保留这些推理预算，其中参数组合并和预算匹配的多导师策略蒸馏将三个领域专家整合到一个模型中。经过36T token的预训练后，增加推理深度使Accordion-6B-A0.5B在37项任务上的五类宏观平均提升了3.01个百分点，其中中间预算利用一半的额外层执行捕获了89%的增益。最终模型在对应任务和预算的平均值上超越了每个领域专家，同时在所有预算上实现了强大的指令遵循性能，并在数学推理和代码生成中保留了与深度相关的增益。

articles.title: When Agents Fail: Model or Harness--Who's to Blame?
articles.abstract: LLM agents combine models with execution harnesses, so agentic benchmark performance reflects their joint behavior. We argue that harnesses should therefore be evaluated through their interactions with underlying models. We develop a framework combining five complementary measures: (i) Valid Completion Rate (VCR), how reliably agents finish normally and deliver evaluable results, irrespective of task correctness; (ii) Model-Harness Fit, how well a harness supports task achievement through valid completion for a given model; (iii) Cross-Model Fit, a harness's overall suitability across evaluated models; (iv) Interaction Residuals, pairing-specific execution strengths and weaknesses hidden by component-level summaries; and (v) Token Load, the token demands of agent execution, including failed attempts. We evaluate four general-purpose harnesses (OpenCode, Codex CLI, Pi CLI, and DeepAgents) with four core models, plus two fixed native model-harness systems, on six benchmarks covering context management, tool use, long-context planning, multimodal interaction, and artifact handoff. Including native references and stress conditions, 111 evaluation settings yield 52,168 trajectories. Harness rankings vary across models and benchmarks; task performance and valid completion can favor different pairings, and similar task scores can accompany distinct execution profiles. OpenCode ranks first in cross-model performance, while DeepSeek V4 Flash Preview maintains consistently high Mean VCR across harnesses on the shared four-benchmark panel. These findings support evaluating model-harness interactions, training transferable harness-use capabilities in models, and harness designs adapted to the model and task.
articles.titleCn: 代理失败时：是模型还是接口——该由谁负责？
articles.abstractCn: LLM代理将模型与执行框架相结合，因此代理基准性能反映了它们的联合行为。我们认为，因此应通过代理与底层模型的交互来评估框架。我们开发了一个框架，结合了五种互补的度量标准：(i)有效完成率（VCR），即代理可靠地完成常规任务并交付可评估结果的能力，无论任务是否正确；(ii)模型-框架适配度，即框架通过有效完成支持特定模型实现任务的程度；(iii)跨模型适配度，即框架在评估模型中的整体适用性；(iv)交互残差，即组件级摘要隐藏的特定执行优势和劣势；(v)令牌负载，即代理执行所需的令牌量，包括失败尝试。我们使用四个核心模型评估了四个通用框架（OpenCode、Codex CLI、Pi CLI和DeepAgents），以及两个固定的原生模型-框架系统，在涵盖上下文管理、工具使用、长上下文规划、多模态交互和工件交接的六个基准上进行评估。包括原生参考和压力条件，111个评估设置产生了52,168条轨迹。框架排名在不同模型和基准之间有所不同；任务性能和有效完成可能偏爱不同的组合，而相似的任务分数可能伴随着不同的执行特征。OpenCode在跨模型性能中排名第一，而DeepSeek V4 Flash Preview在共享的四个基准面板上始终保持着高平均VCR。这些发现支持评估模型-框架交互，训练模型中可转移的框架使用能力，以及根据模型和任务调整框架设计。

articles.title: Beyond Post-Hoc Rewards: Privileged Reasoning Exploration for Multimodal Embeddings
articles.abstract: Advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have driven substantial progress in multimodal embeddings. Recent methods exploit generative capabilities by augmenting embedded inputs with self-generated reasoning to produce more informative embeddings. However, conventional retrieval supervision for training embedding models specifies pairwise relevance relations without explicitly guiding the reasoning used for input augmentation. Such reasoning is neither directly observed nor uniquely determined by the input, allowing multiple plausible traces to introduce semantic cues of varying retrieval utility. Existing approaches largely optimize reasoning conditioned on the input alone, limiting the exploration of retrieval-relevant traces. We introduce PILOT, a framework that models reasoning as a latent variable and instantiates its prior and posterior distributions as distinct reasoning modes of a shared MLLM. The prior conditions only on the input, whereas the posterior uses additional training-time relational evidence to guide reasoning exploration. To translate the posterior's broader exploration into inference-time improvements, we derive an importance-weighted variational objective and instantiate it as a prior-posterior co-evolution framework that improves both modes under a shared inference-compatible reward while selectively transferring posterior trajectories to the prior according to their utility and prior reachability. On the 78-task MMEB-V2 benchmark, PILOT outperforms the primary baseline across all 12 task groups at both 2B and 7B parameters, improving overall scores by 3.2 and 3.3 points, respectively, with the largest gains in visual-document retrieval (+6.1 and +6.4 points). Our results show that relational supervision is most valuable not as a post-hoc reward but as a signal for shaping how reasoning is explored in training reasoning-enhanced embedding models.
articles.titleCn: 超越事后奖励：多模态嵌入的特权推理探索
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）的进步推动了多模态嵌入技术的显著发展。近期方法通过为嵌入输入补充自我生成的推理来利用生成能力，从而产生更信息丰富的嵌入。然而，传统的用于训练嵌入模型的检索监督指定了成对的相关性关系，而没有明确指导用于输入增强的推理。这种推理既没有被直接观察到，也无法由输入唯一确定，使得多个可能的推理路径引入了检索效用不同的语义线索。现有方法主要在仅基于输入的条件下优化推理，限制了检索相关推理路径的探索。我们引入了PILOT框架，该框架将推理建模为潜变量，并将其先验和后验分布实例化为共享MLLM的不同推理模式。先验仅依赖于输入，而后验则使用额外的训练时间关系证据来指导推理探索。为了将后验的更广泛探索转化为推理时的改进，我们推导出一个重要性加权的变分目标，并将其实例化为一个先验-后验协同进化框架，该框架在共享的推理兼容奖励下改进两种模式，并根据其效用和先验可达性选择性地将后验轨迹转移到先验。在包含78项任务的MMEB-V2基准测试中，PILOT在2B和7B参数量下均优于主要基线，在所有12个任务组中均取得提升，分别提高了3.2和3.3分，其中视觉-文档检索的增益最大（分别提高6.1和6.4分）。我们的结果表明，关系监督最有价值之处不在于作为事后奖励，而在于作为塑造推理增强嵌入模型训练中推理探索方式的信号。

articles.title: Reading Between the Layers: Cross-Modal Alignment and Representational Hierarchy in Vision Transformers
articles.abstract: While large vision-language models excel at optical character recognition, it remains unclear how their underlying vision encoders process text and its meaning, and whether they support anything resembling reading comprehension. We systematically study transformer-based vision encoders, using cross-modal alignment between rendered text and visual concepts together with probing and retrieval-based analyses as a controlled window into these broader capabilities. Our layer-wise analyses span orthographic, grammatical, and semantic organization, and reveal that strong cross-modal mapping emerges only in the deepest layers, after unimodal object and text recognition have already developed, coinciding with a progression from surface-level to semantic representations. Although this hierarchy is strongest in contrastively trained models, larger self-supervised models and text-rich training data partially support similar behaviors without explicit language supervision. Together, our results suggest that increasing model and training-data scale, as well as text-rich training data, can partially compensate for the absence of language supervision.
articles.titleCn: 《透过层次阅读：视觉Transformer中的跨模态对齐与表征层次结构》
articles.abstractCn: 尽管大型视觉语言模型在光学字符识别方面表现出色，但它们底层的视觉编码器如何处理文本及其含义，以及它们是否支持任何类似于阅读理解的能力，仍然尚不清楚。我们系统地研究了基于Transformer的视觉编码器，通过渲染文本与视觉概念之间的跨模态对齐，并结合探测和基于检索的分析，以此作为一个可控的窗口来洞察这些更广泛的能力。我们的逐层分析涵盖了正字法、语法和语义组织，并揭示出强烈的跨模态映射仅在最深层出现，在单模态对象和文本识别已经发展之后，这与从表层表示到语义表示的进展相吻合。尽管这种层次结构在对比训练的模型中最为强烈，但更大的自监督模型和富含文本的训练数据在不进行显式语言监督的情况下也部分支持类似的行为。综合我们的结果，表明增加模型和训练数据的规模，以及使用富含文本的训练数据，可以在一定程度上弥补缺乏语言监督的不足。

articles.title: Decoupling Patient Personas and Clinical Workflows: A Dual-Agent Approach to Realistic Medical Dialogue Generation
articles.abstract: Pre-consultation medical dialogues are essential for collecting comprehensive patient information, but are costly to obtain at scale due to privacy and ethical constraints. Existing LLM-based synthesis methods often rely on prompt engineering or rigid rules, limiting their ability to balance clinical relevance with realistic patient diversity. We propose CoRPS-Dial, a controllable dual-agent framework for pre-consultation medical dialogue synthesis that integrates patient personas with guideline-aligned clinical workflow rules. CoRPS-Dial generates dialogues through interactions between a persona-driven patient agent and a process-guided doctor agent, followed by post-hoc quality control for role consistency, workflow completeness, and textual consistency. Experiments on coronary heart disease demonstrate that CoRPS-Dial improves alignment between synthetic and real dialogues in information coverage, clinical compliance, and dialogue naturalness. Downstream fine-tuning experiments further confirm the utility of the generated synthetic data for medical dialogue tasks. These results highlight the effectiveness of CoRPS-Dial for clinically grounded and controllable medical dialogue synthesis.
articles.titleCn: 解耦患者角色与临床工作流程：一种用于生成逼真医疗对话的双代理方法
articles.abstractCn: 咨询前的医疗对话对于收集全面的病人信息至关重要，但由于隐私和伦理限制，大规模获取这些信息成本高昂。现有的基于大型语言模型的合成方法通常依赖于提示工程或僵化规则，这限制了它们在平衡临床相关性与真实病人多样性方面的能力。我们提出了CoRPS-Dial，这是一个可控的双代理框架，用于咨询前医疗对话的合成，该框架将病人角色与符合指南的临床工作流程规则相结合。CoRPS-Dial通过一个由角色驱动的病人代理和一个由流程指导的医生代理之间的交互来生成对话，随后进行事后质量控制，以确保角色一致性、工作流程完整性和文本一致性。在冠心病上的实验表明，CoRPS-Dial提高了合成对话与真实对话在信息覆盖范围、临床合规性和对话自然度方面的匹配度。下游的微调实验进一步证实了生成的合成数据在医疗对话任务中的实用性。这些结果突出了CoRPS-Dial在临床基础可控的医疗对话合成方面的有效性。

articles.title: SCI-AGENT-EXAM: Benchmarking Agents on Scientific Research Tasks
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly capable of supporting scientific workflows, but their capabilities across diverse research activities remain difficult to assess systematically. Existing benchmarks often focus on selected scientific capabilities or task types, limiting a comprehensive characterization of scientific agents' strengths and weaknesses in realistic research workflows. We introduce SCI-AGENT-EXAM, a workflow-oriented benchmark comprising 120 expert-curated tasks across 11 scientific fields and 7 research task types defined by the Scientific Workflow Task Taxonomy (SWTT). Each task requires both executable artifacts (e.g., code and scripts) and textual artifacts (e.g., reports and explanations). To evaluate the heterogeneous task outputs, we develop a hybrid evaluation protocol combining deterministic programmatic verification for executable artifacts with a calibrated, expert-validated LLM-based judge for textual artifacts. Beyond outcome assessment, we analyze progress and solution stability along execution trajectories to characterize how agents reach their final results. Experiments with 10 frontier LLM agents reveal substantial performance gaps: GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest overall score of 80.9, yet only 26.0% of its runs exceed the 0.95 success threshold. Further analyses uncover distinct capability profiles across scientific task types and substantial variation in execution efficiency and stability. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/SKYLENAGE-AI/Sci-Agent-Exam.
articles.titleCn: SCI-AGENT-EXAM：在科学研究任务上对智能体进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理在支持科学工作流程方面正变得越来越强大，但它们在不同研究活动中的能力仍然难以系统性地评估。现有的基准测试通常专注于选定的科学能力或任务类型，这限制了科学代理在现实研究工作流程中的优势和劣势的全面表征。我们介绍了SCI-AGENT-EXAM，这是一个以工作流程为导向的基准测试，包含11个科学领域和科学工作流程任务分类法（SWTT）定义的7种研究任务类型中的120个由专家策划的任务。每个任务都需要可执行工件（例如，代码和脚本）和文本工件（例如，报告和解释）。为了评估异构任务输出，我们开发了一种混合评估协议，结合了对可执行工件的确定性程序化验证和对文本工件的校准、专家验证的基于LLM的评判。除了结果评估外，我们还分析了执行轨迹中的进展和解决方案稳定性，以表征代理如何达到最终结果。对10个前沿LLM代理的实验揭示了显著的性能差距：GPT-6 Astra获得了最高的总体分数80.9，但只有26.0%的运行超过了0.95的成功阈值。进一步分析揭示了不同科学任务类型之间的能力差异以及执行效率和稳定性的显著变化。我们的代码和数据可在https://github.com/SKYLENAGE-AI/Sci-Agent-Exam获取。

articles.title: Profile-Driven User Simulation via Reinforcement Learning with Hierarchical Rewards for Task-Oriented Dialogues
articles.abstract: Building Task-Oriented Dialogue (TOD) systems for high-value scenarios such as financial marketing requires large volumes of domain-specific dialogue data, which privacy regulations, annotation costs, and the need for expert labor make hard to obtain. User simulation offers a remedy, but existing methods target general-domain dialogue and exhibit two key limitations: insufficient modeling of domain-specific business processes and compliance constraints, and inadequate capture of the colloquial, spoken-language character of voice interactions. We propose ProfileSim, a profile-driven user simulation framework for financial marketing outbound calls. It jointly models user profiles---demographics and Big Five personality traits---and business profiles---intents reverse-engineered from real call logs---enabling fine-grained control over simulated behavior. The base model is fine-tuned on real voice dialogue data and refined by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with hierarchical rewards at the dialogue and utterance levels. Paired with a customer service agent integrating Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) constraints and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), ProfileSim achieves the highest colloquial naturalness, the strongest user profile adherence and the lowest agent score on long-tail intents among all evaluated user generators, while producing substantially shorter user utterances at comparable business compliance. The generated dialogue data is designed to support intent recognition training, agent evaluation, and rapid cold-start deployment.
articles.titleCn: 基于强化学习与分层奖励的任务导向对话用户仿真
articles.abstractCn: 为金融营销等高价值场景构建面向任务的对话（TOD）系统需要大量特定领域的对话数据，但隐私法规、标注成本以及专家劳动力的需求使得获取这些数据变得困难。用户模拟提供了一种解决方案，但现有方法主要针对通用领域对话，存在两大关键局限性：对特定领域业务流程和合规约束的建模不足，以及对语音交互中口语化、口语特征的不充分捕捉。我们提出了ProfileSim，一个用于金融营销外呼的用户模拟框架，该框架以用户画像驱动，联合建模用户画像（人口统计特征和五大性格特质）和业务画像（从真实通话记录中逆向工程出的意图），从而实现对模拟行为的细粒度控制。基础模型在真实语音对话数据上进行微调，并通过对话级和语句级的分层奖励使用群体相对策略优化（GRPO）进行优化。与集成了标准操作程序（SOP）约束和检索增强生成（RAG）的客户服务代理相结合，ProfileSim在所有评估的用户生成器中实现了最高的口语自然度、最强的用户画像遵循度以及最低的代理长尾意图得分，同时在业务合规度相当的情况下生成了显著更短的用户语句。生成的对话数据旨在支持意图识别训练、代理评估和快速冷启动部署。

articles.title: Cycle-of-Thought: Self-Evaluative Iterative Reasoning for Table Visual Question Answering in Document Images
articles.abstract: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have significantly improved Visual Question Answering (VQA) performance, yet their reasoning over structured content such as tables remains inconsistent, often plagued by spatial misalignment and logical hallucinations. Existing approaches for improving table VQA typically rely on architectural modifications or expensive supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which impose high barriers to entry due to the need for large-scale, expert-annotated datasets and significant computational resources. In this work, we propose Self-RefineVQA, a training-free, inference-time self-correction framework that improves table VQA performance without additional labeled data or model updates. Inspired by human revision behavior, our method enables a single VLM to iteratively act as a generator, critic, and refiner, forming a closed self-feedback loop that corrects common reasoning errors through prompt-guided re-evaluation. Experiments on tabular VQA benchmarks demonstrate that Self-RefineVQA yields consistent accuracy gains in monolingual and cross-lingual understanding, with a particularly significant boost for small models, enabling lightweight models (e.g., 2B-7B parameters) to rival the performance of significantly larger counterparts. Furthermore, we provide a comparative complexity analysis demonstrating that while inference cost increases linearly, our framework offers superior data efficiency and a lower cumulative cost by eliminating the prohibitive annotation bottleneck of human labeling required for fine-tuning. Our results highlight the potential of prompt-based self-improvement as a scalable, accessible paradigm for reliable table reasoning in VLMs.
articles.titleCn: 思维循环：文档图像表格视觉问答中的自我评估迭代推理
articles.abstractCn: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）的最新进展显著提升了视觉问答（VQA）的性能，但它们在处理表格等结构化内容时的推理能力仍不稳定，常受空间错位和逻辑幻觉问题困扰。现有的表格VQA改进方法通常依赖于架构修改或昂贵的监督微调（SFT），由于需要大规模专家标注数据集和大量计算资源，因此存在较高的进入门槛。在本工作中，我们提出了Self-RefineVQA，这是一种无需训练、在推理时进行自我修正的框架，能够在无需额外标注数据或模型更新的情况下提升表格VQA性能。受人类修订行为的启发，我们的方法使单个VLM能够迭代地充当生成器、批评家和修正者，形成一个闭环自我反馈循环，通过提示引导的重新评估来纠正常见的推理错误。在表格VQA基准测试上的实验表明，Self-RefineVQA在单语和跨语理解方面均能实现稳定的准确率提升，尤其对小模型效果显著，使轻量级模型（例如2B-7B参数）能够媲美更大模型的性能。此外，我们提供了比较复杂度分析，证明虽然推理成本线性增加，但我们的框架通过消除微调所需的人为标注的极端瓶颈，提供了更高的数据效率和更低的累积成本。我们的结果表明，基于提示的自我改进具有作为可扩展、易访问范式的潜力，为VLMs中的可靠表格推理提供支持。

articles.title: Can LLM Annotators Match Human Consistency? Benchmarking Human Agreement and Optimizing Multi-Agent with Contrastive Knowledge
articles.abstract: LLM-based annotation has advanced rapidly, yet existing benchmarks remain misaligned with real-world practice. Actual annotation often involves lengthy, task-specific guidelines, and different annotators may produce divergent but reasonable judgments, especially on boundary cases, where single-labeled dataset fail to reflect this disagreement. This gap also limits existing single-agent and workflow-based annotation systems, which often lack adaptability to complex, evolving guidelines. To bridge this gap, we introduce ANT-A Benchmark, a real-world multi-annotator benchmark spanning 7 datasets across domains and modalities, with task-specific guidelines and 5 independent human labels per instance. ANT-A enables a distribution-aware evaluation, using Fleiss kappa to assess how closely model annotations align with human labeling distributions. We further propose ANT-OR, a multi-agent annotation framework that refines prompts by distilling contrastive decision rules from positive and negative feedback. Experiments show that ANT-OR improves agreement@>=2 accuracy by 4.5 points over the strongest baseline and achieves the highest alignment with human annotator distributions as measured by Fleiss kappa within 2 points. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/Krueske/ANT-OR.
articles.titleCn: LLM标注员能否匹配人类一致性？基准测试人类协议并优化多智能体对比知识
articles.abstractCn: 基于LLM的标注技术发展迅速，但现有的基准测试仍与现实中的实践脱节。实际标注通常涉及详长、任务特定的指南，不同的标注者可能会做出不同但合理的判断，尤其是在边界情况下，单一标签的数据集无法反映这种分歧。这一差距也限制了现有的单代理和基于工作流的标注系统，这些系统通常缺乏对复杂、演变指南的适应性。为弥合这一差距，我们引入了ANT-A基准测试，这是一个涵盖跨领域和模态的7个数据集的真实世界多标注者基准，具有任务特定的指南，每个实例有5个独立的人类标签。ANT-A能够进行分布感知评估，使用Fleiss kappa来评估模型标注与人类标签分布的一致性。我们进一步提出了ANT-OR，一个多代理标注框架，该框架通过从正面和负面反馈中提炼对比决策规则来优化提示。实验表明，ANT-OR将≥2的一致性准确率提高了4.5个百分点，并在Fleiss kappa指标上以2个百分点的差距实现了与人类标注者分布的最高一致性。代码和基准测试可在https://github.com/Krueske/ANT-OR获取。

articles.title: A Broader Look into MLLM's Retrieval Heads
articles.abstract: Locating relevant evidence in long inputs is a core capability of Multimodal Large Language Models. Prior studies attribute this capability to retrieval heads, a sparse set of attention heads that transfer information from the context to the output. However, these analyses are confined to a limited set of modalities and the corresponding models. Moreover, how retrieval heads can be leveraged to enhance the model calls for further exploration. In this paper, we ask whether this mechanism expands together with the input modalities of the model. Taking audio-visual input as a newly added modality, we construct paired inputs in which the same answer is either spoken or shown on screen. With the evidence content fixed, retrieval heads remain sparse in the new modality and are shared to a large extent across modalities. Across 18 language, vision-language, and omni-modal checkpoints, omni-modal models largely preserve the retrieval heads of their backbones. Ablating these heads eliminates nearly all audio-visual retrieval. The heads shared across modalities make up fewer than 2\% of all heads, yet ablating them also degrades document understanding, spatial perception, and visual mathematics. Building on these findings, we turn retrieval heads into a target of optimization by training their attention with a ranking objective. This raises the page Recall@1 of Qwen3-VL-8B on MMDocIR by 6.03 points and improves document retrieval across three model families. Functional attention heads can thus serve both as a lens on multimodal models and as a target for improving them.
articles.titleCn: 对MLLM检索头的更深入探讨
articles.abstractCn: 在长输入中定位相关证据是多模态大型语言模型的核心能力。先前研究将此能力归因于检索头，这是一种稀疏的注意力头，将信息从上下文传递到输出。然而，这些分析仅限于有限数量的模态和相应的模型。此外，如何利用检索头来增强模型尚需进一步探索。在本文中，我们探究这种机制是否随着模型输入模态的增加而扩展。以视听输入作为新增模态为例，我们构建了配对输入，其中相同答案要么被口头说出，要么在屏幕上显示。在证据内容固定的情况下，检索头在新模态中保持稀疏，并且在跨模态方面共享程度较高。在18个语言、视觉语言和全模态检查点中，全模态模型在很大程度上保留了其骨干模型的检索头。移除这些头几乎消除了所有视听检索。跨模态共享的头数不到所有头的2%，但移除它们也会降低文档理解、空间感知和视觉数学能力。基于这些发现，我们将检索头转变为优化目标，通过使用排序目标训练其注意力。这使Qwen3-VL-8B在MMDocIR上的Page Recall@1提升了6.03分，并提高了三个模型系列的文档检索能力。功能注意力头因此既可作为多模态模型的视角，也可作为改进它们的靶标。

articles.title: Acoustic and Lexical Signals for Native Language Identification of Language Learners
articles.abstract: Spoken native language (L1) identification for second language learners has traditionally relied on acoustic attributes of speech. Comparatively little attention has been paid to analysing speech transcripts for L1 traces. In this paper, we present a study of L1 identification using both speech and corresponding transcripts from a spoken learner English corpus. We compare a WavLM-based audio L1 classifier with a zero-shot GPT-4o classifier operating on transcripts and analyse their predictions across proficiency levels using a CEFR-balanced evaluation set. Our experiments show that the audio classifier outperforms the transcript-based approach overall when full transcripts are available, although their relative strengths vary with learner proficiency. Audio performs better at A1, whereas text performs better from A2 to C1 with full transcripts. Transcript-based accuracy generally increases with proficiency, while acoustic performance remains comparatively stable. Restricting transcript length substantially reduces text-based accuracy, whereas audio is less sensitive to input length and performs relatively well with limited input. These findings provide insights into L1 identification from acoustic and textual representations of learner speech and how performance varies with proficiency and the amount of available language material.
articles.titleCn: 用于母语识别的语言学习者的声学和词汇信号
articles.abstractCn: 针对二语学习者的母语（L1）识别传统上依赖于语音的声学特征。相比之下，对语音文本进行L1痕迹分析的研究关注较少。在本文中，我们使用口语英语语料库中的语音及其对应的文本，进行了一项关于L1识别的研究。我们比较了基于WavLM的音频L1分类器与在文本上运行的零样本GPT-4o分类器，并使用CEFR平衡评估集分析它们在不同熟练程度下的预测。我们的实验表明，当有完整文本时，音频分类器总体上表现优于基于文本的方法，尽管它们的相对优势随学习者熟练程度而变化。在A1水平上，音频表现更好；而在有完整文本的情况下，从A2到C1水平，文本表现更优。基于文本的准确率通常随熟练程度提高而增加，而声学性能则相对稳定。限制文本长度会显著降低基于文本的准确率，而音频对输入长度不太敏感，在有限输入情况下仍能相对良好地表现。这些发现为从学习者语音的声学和文本表示中识别L1提供了见解，并揭示了性能如何随熟练程度和可用语言材料的数量而变化。

articles.title: Why Full-Duplex Speech Models Collapse in Long Conversations
articles.abstract: Full-duplex speech models listen and speak at the same time, which makes them promising for natural, open-ended conversation. But can they sustain a coherent conversation for tens of minutes? Because they generate a token every frame, even while listening, they exhaust their context windows within minutes. Yet existing benchmarks evaluate only single turns or a few conversational rounds, too short to expose the long-horizon problem. We introduce the Full-Duplex Long-Horizon Benchmark (FD-LHB), which tests five recent full-duplex models on long replayed conversations and in live conversation with an LLM partner. Every evaluated model eventually either degrades or exhausts its context. Models that keep the full history often degrade before their context runs out, while sliding-window models still fall into repetition, silence, and gibberish. For sliding-window models, we identify two contributing mechanisms. Gibberish and silence are linked to Initialization-Anchor Eviction, where the sliding window discards the first KV entry. Repetition is also reinforced by the model's own recent outputs. Guided by this diagnosis, we apply two simple fixes: Initialization-Anchor Pinning (IAP) keeps that first entry, and Duplex Repetition Penalty (DRP) discourages echoing while guarding against prolonged silence. Together, they support the diagnosis and, without retraining, substantially reduce conversational collapse in replays of up to an hour while running in real time.
articles.titleCn: 为什么全双工语音模型在长对话中会崩溃
articles.abstractCn: 全双工语音模型能够同时倾听和说话，这使得它们在自然、开放式对话方面具有潜力。但它们能否维持几十分钟连贯的对话呢？由于它们在倾听时每帧都生成一个token，因此它们在几分钟内就会耗尽其上下文窗口。然而，现有的基准测试仅评估单轮或几轮对话，时间太短，无法暴露长时问题。我们引入了全双工长时基准（FD-LHB），该基准测试五个最近的全双工模型在长时间重播对话以及与LLM伙伴的实时对话中的表现。每个被评估的模型最终要么性能下降，要么耗尽其上下文。保持完整历史的模型往往在上下文耗尽前性能下降，而滑动窗口模型仍然会陷入重复、沉默和无意义的话语中。对于滑动窗口模型，我们识别出两种贡献机制。无意义的话语和沉默与初始化锚点驱逐有关，即滑动窗口会丢弃第一个KV条目。重复现象也受到模型近期输出本身的强化。根据这一诊断，我们应用了两个简单的修复措施：初始化锚点固定（IAP）保留了该第一个条目，而双工重复惩罚（DRP）则抑制了回声，同时防止长时间的沉默。它们共同支持了诊断结果，在不重新训练的情况下，在实时运行时，显著减少了长达一个小时的对话重播中的对话崩溃现象。

articles.title: Beyond Final Outcomes: Quantifying Claim-Level Information Dynamics in Multi-Agent LLM Interaction
articles.abstract: When LLM-powered agents interact, information is repeatedly shared, expanded, and forgotten, yet multi-agent evaluation typically focuses on final task outcomes. We study such interaction as claim-level information dynamics and propose RIVER, which decomposes agent outputs into atomic claims and evaluates three complementary dimensions: convergence, exploration, and retention. Convergence captures cross-agent claim correspondence and stance alignment; exploration captures semantic breadth and extension beyond the source; and retention tracks source preservation and the persistence of new claims across stages and lineages. We evaluate five interaction strategies on 40 controlled news-generation cases. Repeatedly pooled interaction promotes convergence but narrows the information space, whereas distributed relay yields broader, less shared information. Further comparisons show that method-specific constraints increase exploration while weakening convergence and retention. Our findings suggest that collective information dynamics are better explained by underlying information-flow mechanisms than by simple downstream performance.
articles.comment: 23 pages, 3 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/fzj-2023/RIVER
articles.titleCn: 超越最终结果：量化多智能体LLM交互中的声明级信息动态
articles.abstractCn: 当基于LLM的智能体进行交互时，信息会反复被共享、扩展和遗忘，然而多智能体评估通常只关注最终的任务结果。我们研究这种交互行为，将其称为声明级信息动态，并提出了RIVER方法，该方法将智能体的输出分解为原子声明，并评估三个互补的维度：收敛性、探索性和保留性。收敛性捕捉跨智能体声明的对应关系和立场一致性；探索性捕捉语义广度和超越源信息的扩展；保留性追踪源信息的保留以及新声明在阶段和谱系中的持久性。我们在40个受控的新闻生成案例上评估了五种交互策略。反复聚合交互促进了收敛性，但缩小了信息空间，而分布式中继则产生了更广泛但共享较少的信息。进一步比较表明，特定方法的约束增加了探索性，同时削弱了收敛性和保留性。我们的研究表明，集体信息动态可以通过潜在的信息流机制来更好地解释，而不是通过简单的下游性能。

articles.title: 4DMemory: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Spatiotemporal Memory with Harness-Augmented Agents
articles.abstract: Humans efficiently process multimodal streams spanning hours to years, building persistent, fine-grained spatiotemporal memories that support reasoning about and predicting long-horizon events. In contrast, existing benchmarks focus on short- and medium-context tasks, and most foundation models struggle to preserve fine-grained information over long horizons. To evaluate and improve long-horizon spatiotemporal reasoning, we introduce the LongVideo dataset and the 4DMemoryBench. LongVideo comprises about 900 hours of video and over 5,000 manually reviewed questions covering visual, textual, and spatiotemporal reasoning across diverse context lengths. We further develop the 4DMemory Harness, which integrates four complementary skills, 22+ specialized tool models, and a model-specific retrieval-augmented generation system. Evaluating 13 leading models, we find that standalone foundation models struggle with long-horizon tasks, while the 4DMemory Harness improves all of them by over 50\%. Compared to previous benchmark, the same models exhibit a performance drop of more than 10\% on 4DMemoryBench. We hope 4DMemory will facilitate the development of spatiotemporal agents capable of addressing complex, long-horizon tasks.
articles.titleCn: 4DMemory：基于增强智能体的长时程时空记忆基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 人类能够高效地处理跨越数小时至数年的多模态信息流，构建持久且细粒度的时空记忆，从而支持对长期事件的推理和预测。相比之下，现有的基准主要关注短中和中等长度的任务，大多数基础模型难以在长期范围内保留细粒度信息。为了评估和改进长期时空推理能力，我们引入了LongVideo数据集和4DMemoryBench。LongVideo包含约900小时的视频和超过5000个经过人工审核的问题，涵盖了不同长度背景下的视觉、文本和时空推理。我们进一步开发了4DMemory Harness，该系统集成了四种互补技能、22个以上专业工具模型以及一个针对特定模型的检索增强生成系统。评估13个领先模型后，我们发现独立的基础模型在长期任务上表现不佳，而4DMemory Harness使所有模型的性能均提升了50%以上。与之前的基准相比，这些模型在4DMemoryBench上的性能下降超过10%。我们希望4DMemory能够促进具有处理复杂长期任务能力的时空智能体的开发。

articles.title: System One models Are Not Better Rerankers
articles.abstract: System One models, or decision models, answer a question about an input with a calibrated probability instead of generated text. Within weeks of the first release, in September 2026, they were used as rerankers. We test whether the decision fine-tuning behind them makes a better reranker than plain reranker fine-tuning of the same model. For six Qwen backbones from 0.6B to 27B parameters and ten TREC DL and BEIR collections, we compare the untuned model, asked zero-shot, with its decision fine-tunes and its reranker fine-tunes, two of which we train ourselves. In our work, we draw the conclusion that decision fine-tuning never makes the better reranker. From 0.6B to 9B, reranker fine-tuning wins on every backbone by 5 to 29 points nDCG@10, also on zero-shot collections, and at 27B the two tie. Up to 9B, decision fine-tuning adds nothing over simply asking the untuned model. Moreover, we find that the calibration advantage of decision models depends on the question. Asked whether a passage answers the query, they are better calibrated than the published reranker fine-tunes from 4B on. Asked a slightly different question from prior work, they lose this advantage. Lastly, calibration does not make up for a worse ranking: up to 9B, a reranker fine-tune keeps the better passages at a fixed threshold. If you need a reranker, fine-tune a reranker.
articles.titleCn: 系统一号模型并非更好的重排序器
articles.abstractCn: 系统一模型，或决策模型，通过校准概率回答输入问题，而不是生成文本。在2026年9月首次发布后的几周内，它们被用作重新排序器。我们测试了它们背后的决策微调是否比相同模型的纯重新排序器微调更能胜任重新排序器。对于从0.6B到27B参数的六个Qwen主干和十个TREC DL和BEIR数据集，我们比较了未微调的模型（零样本提问）、其决策微调和其重新排序器微调，其中两个是我们自行训练的。在我们的工作中，我们得出结论，决策微调从未使重新排序器更出色。从0.6B到9B，重新排序器微调在每个主干上以5到29点的nDCG@10优势获胜，在零样本数据集上也同样如此，在27B时两者持平。至9B，决策微调并未在未微调模型上带来任何额外优势。此外，我们发现决策模型的校准优势取决于问题。当被问及段落是否回答查询时，它们比4B及以上的已发布重新排序器微调更准确。当被问及与先前工作略有不同的问题时，它们会失去这种优势。最后，校准无法弥补更差的排序：至9B，重新排序器微调能在固定阈值下保持更好的段落。如果你需要一个重新排序器，就微调一个重新排序器。

articles.title: Many Perturbations, Shared Failure Dynamics: Tracing Direction-Sensitive Perturbation Influence in Language Models
articles.abstract: Why can a task-preserving rewrite turn a correct answer into a failure while a larger internal change leaves the answer intact? We develop a direction-sensitive, readout-relative account of semantic fragility: heterogeneous language changes can share geometric and readout relationships without sharing an input-independent failure direction. Clean decision reserve, representation transformation, and response alignment provide complementary descriptions of this process. An exact longitudinal-transverse decomposition identifies directional information discarded by scalar transmission. A compact reserve-and-transmission model predicts failures across held-out families and items in Qwen3-32B and Gemma 4 31B, with useful but parameterization-dependent transfer to ReClor. Matched interventions show that orientation carries causal information beyond scalar geometry. Among naturally failed rewrites, attention-component tests on disjoint original items and subsequent answer-order controls favor the natural paired direction over tested random and same-answer-letter donor directions. Yet failures rarely persist across option orders, and current-order corrections use recomputed clean references. Shared predictive regularity thus coexists with context-dependent directional effects. Numerical path integration reduces, but does not eliminate, finite-patch approximation error within a fixed context; a larger discrepancy from the natural rewrite effect remains. A complementary fixed-CoT cue study extends this account to influence unacknowledged in recorded reasoning: readout associations transfer across domains, although the positive-mean causal criterion fails and signed-effect prediction remains post hoc. Together, these results support shared relations among reserve, transformation, and response while distinguishing local causal sensitivity from a complete explanation of natural failure.
articles.titleCn: 多种扰动，共享失效动态：追踪语言模型中方向敏感扰动影响
articles.abstractCn: 为什么一个任务保留的重写会将有正确答案的情况转变为失败，而一个更大的内部变化却能让答案保持完整？我们提出了一个方向敏感、读数相对的语义脆弱性解释：异构语言变化可以共享几何和读数关系，而无需共享与输入无关的失败方向。清洁决策储备、表示转换和响应对齐为这一过程提供了互补的描述。精确的纵向-横向分解识别了标量传输中丢弃的方向信息。一个紧凑的储备和传输模型预测了Qwen3-32B和Gemma 4 31B中保留在外部的家族和项目的失败，并具有参数化相关的有用迁移到ReClor。匹配干预表明，方向传递了标量几何之外的因果信息。在自然失败的改写中，对不相关原始项目的注意力组件测试和后续答案顺序控制倾向于自然配对方向，而非测试的随机方向和相同答案字母的供体方向。然而，失败很少跨越选项顺序，当前顺序的修正使用重新计算的清洁参考。因此，共享的预测规律性与依赖上下文的方向效应共存。数值路径积分减少了固定上下文中有限块近似误差，但并未完全消除；与自然改写效应的更大差异仍然存在。一个互补的固定CoT提示研究将这一解释扩展到影响未记录推理：读数关联跨领域传递，尽管正均值的因果标准失败，且符号效应预测仍为事后分析。这些结果共同支持储备、转换和响应之间的共享关系，同时区分了局部因果敏感性与自然失败的完整解释。

articles.title: DMAIC-Bench: From Self-Reflection to Self-Restraint for Agents in Multi-Stage Analytical Tasks
articles.abstract: Multi-stage analytical tasks require LLM agents to use intermediate evidence to decide whether to continue, redirect or stop. Self-reflection, in which an agent critiques its output, is widely studied, yet a critique does not show whether evidence changed the next action. We call that capability self-restraint. Existing agent benchmarks largely measure task completion or output quality and leave it untested. DMAIC-Bench evaluates it with 97 seeded tasks across 15 industrial cases in four sectors, built around Lean Six Sigma's explicit statistical prerequisites. Paired counterfactual variants require opposite actions at the same workflow position, distinguishing warranted restraint from indiscriminate stopping. We assess execution traces with a private scorer and final claims through independent expert review. Across 13 models from six providers, execution-level routing accuracy averages 92% on matched GO decisions and 19% on NO-GO decisions, counting any forbidden downstream computation as a route error. Execution traces show agents reporting correct diagnostics before performing analyses that those results disallow. Separately, blinded expert review of the 11 audited agents estimates that reports act on invalid evidence at 47% of reached NO-GO decisions, with an interval from 31% to 61%. Explicit stopping permission helps some models without consistently restoring correct decisions at both GO and NO-GO forks. Sixteen life-sciences tasks in bulk ribonucleic acid sequencing (RNA-seq) and case-control genome-wide association studies (GWAS) show that the same framework can evaluate evidence-dependent decisions beyond industrial workflows. Project code and data are available at: https://github.com/psptpx/DMAIC-Bench-public.
articles.titleCn: DMAIC-Bench：面向多阶段分析任务中智能体的自我反思到自我约束
articles.abstractCn: 多阶段分析任务需要大语言模型代理利用中间证据来决定是否继续、重定向或停止。自我反思，即代理对其输出进行批判，已被广泛研究，但批判并不能表明证据是否改变了后续行动。我们将这种能力称为自我约束。现有的代理基准主要衡量任务完成度或输出质量，而未对此进行测试。DMAIC-Bench通过围绕精益六西格玛明确统计要求构建的、涵盖四个行业15个工业案例的97个种子任务，评估了这一能力。配对的反事实变体要求在相同的工作流程位置采取相反的行动，以区分合理的约束与非审慎的停止。我们通过私有评分器评估执行轨迹，并通过独立专家评审最终声明。在来自六个供应商的13个模型中，执行级别的路由平均准确率在匹配的GO决策上为92%，在NO-GO决策上为19%，将任何禁止的下游计算都计为路由错误。执行轨迹显示代理在执行那些结果不允许的分析前报告了正确的诊断。此外，对11个经过审计的代理的盲法专家评审估计，在达到的NO-GO决策中，有47%的报告基于无效证据，范围在31%到61%之间。明确的停止许可帮助某些模型，但并未始终在GO和NO-GO分叉点恢复正确的决策。批量RNA测序（RNA-seq）和病例对照全基因组关联研究（GWAS）中的16个生命科学任务表明，相同的框架可以评估超出工业工作流程的证据相关决策。项目代码和数据可在以下地址获取：https://github.com/psptpx/DMAIC-Bench-public。

articles.title: "Not" is Not Lost in Translation: A Causal Analysis of Negation Representations in Multilingual LLMs
articles.abstract: Negation occurs in every language, yet its surface realization differs drastically. Despite this, multilingual large language models (LLMs) translate negation robustly, raising the question of whether they share an underlying representation of negation across languages. We study this question in six open models across English, French, Vietnamese, and Chinese, using causal interventions on a synthetic contrastive dataset and a negation translation dataset derived from FLORES-200. Across models, we find strong evidence that negation representations are causally controllable and largely shared across languages. In particular, we show that a contrastive activation direction extracted from one language can induce or remove negation in the others, and directions extracted from different languages are substantially aligned. We further find that negation is represented in sparse features: a single sparse autoencoder (SAE) feature per model suffices to control polarity across languages, while responding selectively to negated inputs. Finally, both dense and sparse interventions generalize to four additional languages and FLORES-derived sentences. We release data and code to support future work: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/negation-translation/.
articles.titleCn: "否定"并非翻译失真：多语言大语言模型中否定表示的因果分析
articles.abstractCn: 否定现象存在于所有语言中，但其表层表现形式却差异巨大。尽管如此，多语言大型语言模型（LLM）却能稳健地翻译否定，这引发了它们是否共享跨语言的否定底层表征的问题。我们通过在合成对比数据集和从FLORES-200衍生出的否定翻译数据集上对六种开放模型进行因果干预，研究了这个问题。我们发现，所有模型中，否定表征都具有因果可控性，并且在很大程度上跨语言共享。具体而言，我们证明，从一种语言中提取的对比激活方向可以诱导或消除其他语言的否定，而不同语言提取的方向高度一致。此外，我们发现否定以稀疏特征的形式表示：每个模型的单个稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征就足以控制跨语言的极性，同时选择性地响应带否定输入。最后，密集和稀疏干预都能推广到四种额外的语言和FLORES衍生句子。我们发布了数据和代码以支持未来研究：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/negation-translation/。

articles.title: Do Halting Heads Really Save Compute in Looped Language Models?
articles.abstract: Looped language models run each token through the same layers several times, and each run is one iteration. To save compute, an extra layer, the halting head, gives after each iteration the probability that the token stops there, so that easy tokens can stop early. Pretraining models from scratch, up to 1.3B parameters, we find two problems. First, heads trained on a mix of all iterations predict that tokens need under half the iterations, yet under the standard stopping rule tokens run almost every iteration, because this training never scores the single iteration where a token stops. Scoring every iteration instead fixes this, but in our runs it works only with a strong penalty favoring early stops. Second, savings are commonly reported as an average number of iterations per token, but when sequences are generated in batches that run until their slowest token stops, a model without a head is almost as good at that cost. The reported average can therefore overstate the saving. We recommend reporting the iterations tokens actually run, with the stopping threshold and batch size, and give a test, run before training a head, that bounds its gain.
articles.titleCn: 循环语言模型中，停止头真的能节省计算吗？
articles.abstractCn: 循环语言模型将每个标记通过相同的层多次处理，每次处理称为一次迭代。为了节省计算资源，增加了一个额外的层——停止头，它在每次迭代后给出标记在此停止的概率，以便容易的标记可以提前停止。从头开始预训练模型，参数量高达13亿，我们发现两个问题。首先，在所有迭代混合训练的头部预测标记需要的迭代次数不到一半，但在标准停止规则下，标记几乎每个迭代都会运行，因为这种训练从未评分标记在单个迭代中停止的情况。改为评分每个迭代则可以解决这个问题，但在我们的运行中，这只有在强烈倾向于提前停止的惩罚下才有效。其次，节省通常报告为每个标记的平均迭代次数，但当序列以批次形式生成，直到最慢的标记停止时，没有头部的模型在相同成本下几乎一样好。因此，报告的平均值可能高估了节省。我们建议报告标记实际运行的迭代次数，包括停止阈值和批次大小，并在头部训练前运行一个测试，以界定其收益。

articles.title: DIAL-S2ST: Learning Latency Control for Simultaneous Speech-to-Speech Translation
articles.abstract: We propose DIAL-S2ST, a post-training method for learning inference-time latency control in simultaneous speech-to-speech translation models. Our approach reuses pretrained translation capabilities through self-distillation from lookahead predictions, while limiting the influence of large text distillation losses to account for the imitation gap. This provides supervision for earlier emission without paired target data or reward computation. To make the learned timing adjustable at inference, we jointly train a single LoRA adapter across scales with matched lookahead guidance. Experiments on French-to-English translation with Hibiki demonstrate that only 10 hours of source speech enable this adaptation, providing flexible latency control with a favorable quality-latency trade-off.
articles.titleCn: DIAL-S2ST：学习语音到语音翻译的延迟控制
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了DIAL-S2ST，这是一种用于学习即时推理时延控制的语音到语音翻译模型的训练后方法。我们的方法通过从前瞻预测中进行自蒸馏来重用预训练的翻译能力，同时限制大型文本蒸馏损失的影响以考虑模仿差距。这为早期发射提供了监督，而无需配对目标数据或奖励计算。为了使学习到的时序能够在推理时进行调整，我们联合训练了一个跨尺度的单一LoRA适配器，并匹配前瞻指导。在Hibiki上进行的法语到英语翻译实验表明，仅10小时的源语音即可实现这种自适应，提供灵活的时延控制，并具有有利的质量-时延权衡。

articles.title: Head Dimension Matters in Language Models for Long-Context Retrieval
articles.abstract: Multi-head attention retrieves and combines context representations through query--key interactions and value aggregation, with head dimension constraining the per-head representation space. In long-context processing, it remains unclear whether allocating a fixed parameter budget to fewer, wider heads improves information retrieval. In this paper, we investigate how head dimension affects the performance of long-context retrieval tasks. Our empirical studies reveal that pretraining loss and short-context non-retrieval task performance are not affected much by head dimension, while long-context retrieval performance improves with wider heads at fixed model sizes. We find that models with wider heads have a higher proportion of retrieval heads, associating more parameters with retrieval. Our ablation studies also show that the retrieval performance improves with wider heads even when the projection weights in attention modules are frozen during long-context continual pretraining, suggesting that wider heads not only benefit updates in attention modules but lead to more effective adaptation of components such as embeddings and MLPs.
articles.titleCn: 头维度对用于长上下文检索的语言模型很重要
articles.abstractCn: 多头注意力通过查询-键交互和值聚合来检索和组合上下文表示，其中头维度约束了每个头的表示空间。在长上下文处理中，尚不清楚是否将固定的参数预算分配给更少、更宽的头可以提高信息检索。在本文中，我们研究了头维度如何影响长上下文检索任务的性能。我们的实证研究表明，预训练损失和短上下文非检索任务性能受头维度影响不大，而在固定模型大小下，长上下文检索性能随着更宽的头而提高。我们发现，具有更宽头的模型有更高的检索头比例，将更多参数与检索相关联。我们的消融研究也表明，即使在长上下文持续预训练期间冻结注意力模块中的投影权重，检索性能也会随着更宽的头而提高，这表明更宽的头不仅有利于注意力模块的更新，还导致嵌入和MLP等组件更有效的适应。

articles.title: SOPO: Socratic Guided Policy Optimization for Span-Level Hallucination Detection
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have gained widespread adoption in various natural language processing tasks, but suffer from hallucination issues where they generate unfaithful or inconsistent content. While Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has shown promising applications in reasoning tasks, its application to span-level hallucination detection is challenged by localization ambiguity, reward sparsity on hard examples, and uncontrolled length inflation. To address these issues, we introduce Socratic Guided Policy Optimization (SOPO), a multi-turn RL framework for robust hallucination detection. The key innovation of SOPO is a Socratic feedback mechanism, where a teacher model guides the reasoning trajectories during rollout by providing indirect hints inferred from the ground truth. This teacher-guided approach enables the model to generate more effective reasoning trajectories for hard examples, thus alleviating reward sparsity. Furthermore, we incorporate Turn-based Advantage Scaling to penalize verbosity bias, encouraging the model to develop efficient and autonomous reasoning capabilities. Empirical results on RAGTruth demonstrate that SOPO (4B) achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing leading proprietary models (e.g., GPT-5) and standard RL baselines, while obtaining higher reported mean scores than GRPO on four out-of-domain benchmarks, with mixed evidence against CAPO. We release our training and evaluation code alongside the 1.7B and 4B SOPO models at https://github.com/patsnap/SOPO.
articles.titleCn: SOPO：苏格拉底引导策略优化用于跨度级幻觉检测
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在多种自然语言处理任务中得到了广泛应用，但存在产生不真实或不一致内容（即幻觉）的问题。虽然具有验证性奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在推理任务中展现出良好的应用前景，但将其应用于跨度级别的幻觉检测时面临定位模糊、困难样本奖励稀疏以及不受控的长度膨胀等挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出了苏格拉底引导策略优化（SOPO），这是一种用于鲁棒幻觉检测的多轮强化学习框架。SOPO的关键创新在于引入了苏格拉底式反馈机制，该机制通过教师模型在推理过程中提供间接的提示（这些提示是从真实标签中推断出来的），来引导推理轨迹。这种教师引导的方法使模型能够为困难样本生成更有效的推理轨迹，从而缓解奖励稀疏问题。此外，我们还结合了基于回合的收益缩放技术来惩罚冗长偏差，鼓励模型发展高效且自主的推理能力。在RAGTruth数据集上的实验结果表明，SOPO（4B）达到了当前最佳性能，超越了领先的专有模型（例如GPT-5）和标准RL基线，同时在四个领域外基准测试中获得了比GRPO更高的平均得分，而CAPO的效果则存在争议。我们已将我们的训练和评估代码以及1.7B和4B的SOPO模型发布在https://github.com/patsnap/SOPO。

articles.title: SWE-Shift: Evaluating Coding Agents in Evolving Workspaces
articles.abstract: Repository-level coding benchmarks largely assume that tasks and environments remain unchanged throughout execution. In software development, code, dependencies, runtime state, and requirements can change while an agent is still working. We introduce SWE-Shift, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents under such mid-execution changes. From the same saved history and workspace, a Clean continuation proceeds without intervention, while a matched Shifted continuation receives a task-relevant update. Success requires completing the current task, preserving still-valid work, and satisfying the applicable state and evidence checks. The benchmark contains 120 scenarios across 12 change families, each evaluated at nine scheduled intervention positions. We evaluate 17 coding-agent systems, all of which have lower Shifted than Clean success. GPT-6 Astra drops from 67.35% to 24.79%, with 20.34% paired success. Tool/session changes and stale evidence yield zero paired success across all systems. Late-position paired success is lower for some systems and higher for others. These results show that success on the unchanged task can coexist with failures to preserve work, recover state, or refresh evidence after an update.
articles.titleCn: SWE-Shift：评估在动态工作空间中的编码代理
articles.abstractCn: 仓库级别的编码基准测试通常假设任务和环境在整个执行过程中保持不变。在软件开发中，代码、依赖项、运行时状态和需求可能在代理仍在工作时发生变化。我们引入了SWE-Shift，这是一个用于评估在执行过程中发生此类变化的编码代理的基准测试。从相同的保存历史记录和工作区开始，干净的延续在没有干预的情况下继续进行，而匹配的Shifted延续会收到与任务相关的更新。成功需要完成当前任务、保留仍然有效的工件，并满足适用的状态和证据检查。该基准测试包含12个变化系列中的120个场景，每个场景都在9个预定的干预位置进行评估。我们评估了17个编码代理系统，其中所有系统的Shifted成功率都低于干净的成功率。GPT-6 Astra从67.35%下降到24.79%，有20.34%的配对成功率。工具/会话变化和过时的证据在所有系统中都导致零配对成功率。某些系统的后期位置配对成功率较低，而另一些系统则较高。这些结果表明，在任务未发生变化的情况下取得成功，可以与更新后无法保留工件、恢复状态或刷新证据的失败共存。

articles.title: Collection-Date Assignment Redirects Answers in Temporal QA
articles.abstract: A collection date records when a source revision was acquired, not when its contents changed. Can assigning this metadata redirect temporal question answering despite unchanged evidence? Swapping the question day and following day between two revisions lowers later-reference exact match (EM) by 37.6-51.4 percentage points across five open-weight LLMs on 595 Wikipedia pages, replicated on 128 disjoint pages. Previous-day swaps retain 29.0-39.6-point losses on 497 pages. Seven prompt variants, including explicit ignore-collection instructions and archived-revision provenance, retain the effect. Fictional answers and English month-name question dates show that remembered answers and identical date strings are unnecessary. Matched thinking reduces Qwen3.5's penalty from 30.1 to 11.1 points, while native reasoners vary. Two API LLMs show small Wikipedia swap effects and rarely shift to earlier answers on fictional records. Large swap-induced losses concentrate around the question date; swaps between distant dates have much smaller effects. Adding fields containing one observed acquisition date lowers EM relative to omission in three of five LLMs after correction. The diagnostic isolates metadata effects from changing evidence or missing the relevant revision, and provides a practical audit for temporal QA inputs.
articles.titleCn: 收集日期分配重定向了时间问答中的答案
articles.abstractCn: 一个收集日期记录的是源修订版本何时被获取，而不是其内容何时发生变化。尽管证据未改变，将此元数据分配是否可以调整时间问题的回答？在595个维基百科页面上，通过在两个修订版本之间交换问题日和次日，五个开放权重的大型语言模型（LLM）的后期参考精确匹配（EM）降低了37.6-51.4个百分点，并在128个互不关联的页面上得到了验证。前一天交换在497页上仍保留29.0-39.6个百分点的损失。七种提示变体，包括明确的忽略收集指令和存档修订版本来源，仍然保持这种效果。虚构答案和英文月份名称问题日期表明，记住答案和相同的日期字符串是不必要的。匹配的思维将Qwen3.5的惩罚从30.1降至11.1点，而本地推理者则有所不同。两个API LLM显示较小的维基百科交换效应，并且在虚构记录上很少转向较早的答案。大规模交换引起的损失集中在问题日期周围；远距离日期之间的交换效应要小得多。添加包含一个观察到的获取日期的字段，在修正后，在五个LLM中的三个中降低了EM相对于省略的值。该诊断将元数据效应与证据变化或遗漏相关修订版本分开，并为时间问题的回答输入提供了实用的审计。

articles.title: Depth-Dependent Safety Geometry in Vision-Language Models: Layer-Wise Localization and Bidirectional Refusal Control
articles.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are widely deployed, yet the internal mechanisms behind their safety behavior remain poorly understood. We present a lightweight inference-time framework for localizing and manipulating safety-sensitive representations in frozen VLMs, without retraining or modifying parameters. On Qwen3-VL-4B, layer-wise activation divergence analysis reveals non-uniform safety geometry across depth. Causal interventions show that early vision layers support strong bidirectional refusal control through activation steering along a learned safety direction, with unsafe rejection spanning 6%-96%, whereas later layers respond more to activation magnitude scaling and exhibit a substantial safety-selectivity trade-off. Deeper layers remain well separated along the safety direction yet are largely insensitive to steering, distinguishing representational separability from causal controllability. InternVL2.5-4B shows qualitatively similar depth-dependent activation geometry despite differences in layer location and magnitude. Our results expose a white-box, representation-level refusal-bypass attack surface in VLM vision encoders and motivate inference-time stabilization of safety-sensitive representations.
articles.titleCn: 视觉-语言模型中的深度相关安全几何：逐层定位和双向拒绝控制
articles.abstractCn: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）已得到广泛应用，但它们安全行为背后的内部机制仍缺乏深入理解。我们提出了一种轻量级推理时框架，用于定位和操控冻结VLM中的安全敏感表征，无需重新训练或修改参数。在Qwen3-VL-4B上，逐层激活发散分析揭示了深度方向上非均匀的安全几何结构。因果干预实验表明，早期视觉层通过沿着学习到的安全方向进行激活引导，支持强大的双向拒绝控制，不安全拒绝范围从6%到96%，而后期层则更多地响应激活幅度缩放，并表现出显著的安全选择性权衡。更深层的表征沿安全方向保持良好分离，但对引导不敏感，这区分了表征可分离性与因果可控性。InternVL2.5-4B尽管层位置和幅度存在差异，但也表现出类似的深度相关激活几何结构。我们的结果揭示了VLM视觉编码器中存在白盒、表征级别的拒绝绕过攻击面，并推动了推理时安全敏感表征的稳定化。

articles.title: Not All Information Is Worth Asking For: Decision-Informed Information Seeking with LLMs
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support decisions under incomplete information, where deciding what to look up and when to stop matters as much as the final answer. However, LLMs fall into an information trap: They pay for checks, i.e., costly pieces of evidence, that cannot change their decision or are not worth their cost, and they keep asking when the evidence is already sufficient. To this end, we propose Decision-Informed Value-of-information Acquisition (DIVA), a simple yet effective procedure for LLM information seeking based on the decision value of evidence. DIVA 1) lets the LLM specify a small decision model, i.e., how likely a bad outcome is and how each check would shift this probability, through short numeric questions and 2) values each candidate check by how much its imagined outcomes improve the decision net of its cost, stopping when no check is worth its cost. Its variant, DIVA-U, further accounts for the LLM's uncertain estimates of how strongly each check shifts this probability. DIVA is training-free and applies to any LLM. Across four domains and 20 LLMs, DIVA-U has lower regret, i.e., value lost relative to the best possible decision, than every LLM baseline on real-world data, mainly by stopping once evidence suffices, and DIVA cuts the regret of the best LLM baseline by 75% in synthetic scenarios where every check's reliability is given. Code: github.com/seunghan96/diva.
articles.titleCn: 并非所有信息都值得索取：基于决策的LLM信息获取
articles.abstractCn: 在信息不完整的情况下，大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于支持决策，而决定要查询什么以及何时停止与最终答案同等重要。然而，LLMs会陷入信息陷阱：它们支付检查费用，即昂贵的证据，而这些证据无法改变其决策或价值不值得，并且当证据已经足够时仍会持续查询。为此，我们提出了决策信息价值获取（DIVA），这是一种基于证据决策价值的简单而有效的LLM信息查询程序。DIVA 1）允许LLM通过简短的数字问题指定一个小型决策模型，即坏结果的概率以及每个检查如何改变这种概率，2）通过想象结果对其成本的网络决策改善程度来评估每个候选检查的价值，并在没有检查值得其成本时停止。其变体DIVA-U进一步考虑了LLM对每个检查如何强烈改变这种概率的不确定估计。DIVA是无训练的，适用于任何LLM。在四个领域和20个LLMs中，DIVA-U在真实世界数据上比每个LLM基线具有更低的遗憾，即相对于最佳可能决策损失的价值，这主要是通过在证据足够时停止，而DIVA在每项检查的可靠性都给定的合成场景中，将最佳LLM基线的遗憾减少了75%。代码：github.com/seunghan96/diva。

articles.title: The LLENS Platform for On-Premises Large Language Model Agents in a Japanese University Hospital: Development and Evaluation Study
articles.abstract: Large language model agents that use tools could take on part of the electronic health record and desk work that occupies physicians' time, but in many hospitals the medical information systems run inside closed networks, so the model and the agent harness must also sit inside. We designed, implemented, and deployed LLENS, a clinical support AI agent platform that runs inside the closed network of Hokkaido University Hospital on one host with 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs, the open-weight model Kimi K2.6 (~1 trillion parameters), and a web application rebuilt from Open WebUI. The harness has 10 components, including page image reading, full-text attachment input, a path-addressed document tree without a vector index, a network-isolated sandbox, artifact return, self-checking of generated output, subagents, and saved procedures. Kimi K2.6 was chosen from 3 open-weight candidates and scored 480/500 on the 2026 Japanese Medical Licensing Examination; it generated 119 tokens/s for one user and served 16 concurrent requests at 908 tokens/s in total. On 180 questions over hospital documents (3 seeds each), mean accuracy was 10.7% with no documents, 81.3% with fixed retrieval (top 10 chunks of one lexical search), and 97.2% with interactive access, in which the model reads with document tools and the sandbox (15.9 percentage points above fixed retrieval, 95% CI 10.9-21.3); the difference lay in filtering/counting questions (16.7% vs 87.8%). Five scenarios with synthetic data ran on combinations of the components: needlestick injury response, batch adverse event grading, scanned referral letter transcription, falls data aggregation and plotting, and investigation of 3 topics by subagents. The platform has run on the hospital network since September 14, 2026.
articles.comment: 49 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables, with supplementary material. Submitted to JMIR Medical Informatics
articles.titleCn: 日本大学医院本地大型语言模型代理的LLENS平台：开发与评估研究
articles.abstractCn: 使用工具的大型语言模型代理可以承担部分占用医生时间的电子病历和桌面工作，但在许多医院中，医疗信息系统运行在封闭的网络中，因此模型和代理的 harness 也必须部署在内部。我们设计、实施并部署了 LLENS，这是一个在北海道大学医院封闭网络内运行的临床支持人工智能代理平台，该平台在一台配备 8 块 NVIDIA H200 GPU 的主机上运行，使用开放权重模型 Kimi K2.6（约 1 万亿参数），以及从 Open WebUI 重建的 Web 应用。harness 包含 10 个组件，包括页面图像读取、全文附件输入、无向量索引的路径地址文档树、网络隔离沙箱、结果返回、生成输出的自检、子代理和保存的流程。Kimi K2.6 从 3 个开放权重候选模型中选出，在 2026 年日本医学执照考试中得分 480/500；它为单个用户生成 119 个 token/s，总共处理 16 个并发请求，速度为 908 个 token/s。在 180 个关于医院文档的问题（每个种子 3 个）上，平均准确率在没有文档的情况下为 10.7%，使用固定检索（一个词汇搜索的前 10 个片段）时为 81.3%，使用交互访问时为 97.2%，其中模型通过文档工具和沙箱读取（比固定检索高 15.9 个百分点，95% CI 10.9-21.3）；差异在于问题过滤/计数（16.7% 对 87.8%）。五个使用合成数据的场景在组件组合上运行：针刺伤响应、批量不良事件分级、扫描转诊信件转录、跌倒数据聚合和绘图，以及由子代理调查的 3 个主题。该平台自 2026 年 9 月 14 日起在医院网络中运行。

articles.title: From Promises to Accountability: Comparative AI Modeling and Visualization of Electoral Commitments in Nepali Political Texts
articles.abstract: Election Commitment Mining refers to the analysis of election commitments made by electoral candidates or political parties during election campaigns. However, many elected candidates and political parties, especially in developing South Asian countries, do not fully deliver on the promises they make before elections. Even after the elections, commitments presented through election manifestos, posters, pamphlets, videos, and other campaign materials are often not systematically or transparently archived. As a result, these promises tend to fade away over time, making it difficult to hold the elected candidates accountable for their commitments. To address this persistent issue, this research aims to develop a system capable of structuring the commitments made by candidates during election periods. In this work, we created the first gold-standard dataset of Nepali political texts (Cohen's kappa = 0.777) and evaluated machine learning, deep learning and large language models to automatically extract and analyze election commitments. LaBSE-LR achieved the best results among machine learning models (0.897 accuracy, 0.896 macro F1-score, 0.947 AUROC), while fastText-LSTM achieved the highest performance among deep learning models (0.914 accuracy, 0.913 macro F1-score, 0.961 AUROC). Among the three evaluated large language models, Qwen3-8B performed best in the few-shot setting (0.848 macro F1-score). The outcome of this work is integrated into a mobile application, where commitments can be visualized with the support of GAI, enhancing transparency, civic engagement, and electoral accountability.
articles.comment: Under review at Natural Language Processing (Cambridge University Press); revision submitted. 34 pages, 5 figures, 13 tables
articles.titleCn: 从承诺到问责：尼泊尔政治文本中选举承诺的比较人工智能建模与可视化
articles.abstractCn: 选举承诺挖掘是指对选举期间候选人或政党做出的选举承诺进行分析。然而，许多当选候选人和政党，尤其是在发展中国家，并未完全兑现选举前的承诺。即使在选举之后，通过选举宣言、海报、传单、视频和其他竞选材料呈现的承诺，也往往没有被系统化或透明地存档。因此，这些承诺随着时间的推移逐渐消失，导致难以追究当选候选人对承诺的责任。为解决这一长期存在的问题，本研究旨在开发一个能够结构化选举期间候选人承诺的系统。在这项工作中，我们创建了首个尼泊尔政治文本黄金标准数据集（Cohen's kappa = 0.777），并评估了机器学习、深度学习和大型语言模型，以自动提取和分析选举承诺。在机器学习模型中，LaBSE-LR取得了最佳结果（0.897准确率，0.896宏观F1分数，0.947AUROC），而在深度学习模型中，fastText-LSTM表现最佳（0.914准确率，0.913宏观F1分数，0.961AUROC）。在评估的三种大型语言模型中，Qwen3-8B在少样本设置下表现最佳（0.848宏观F1分数）。这项工作的成果被整合到一个移动应用程序中，借助GAI的支持，可以可视化展示承诺，从而提高透明度、公民参与度和选举问责制。

articles.title: Disentangling Question, Response, and Verifier Languages in Multilingual P(True) Self-Evaluation
articles.abstract: When a language model is asked whether its own answer is correct, three languages are involved: that of the question, that requested for the answer, and that of the verifier instruction asking for the judgment. Multilingual confidence evaluations seldom separate the three. We vary them independently in a six-language factorial design with ten open-weight models (3B-14B) on LSQA, MMMLU and TriviaQA, holding each answer fixed across verifier languages and measuring confidence with a first-token P(True) probe. The three languages move different parts of the evaluation: which of them governs accuracy depends on the benchmark, matching the response language to the question or verifier language sharpens discrimination but not calibration, and the verifier language alone shifts calibration error by up to 0.04 without changing accuracy. The scorer matters as well: an unvalidated judge would have shrunk the MMMLU English-Hindi accuracy gap from 0.198 to 0.038. Multilingual confidence results, model rankings included, are therefore comparable only when all three languages are reported and the scorer is validated.
articles.titleCn: 在多语言P(True)自我评估中分离问题、回答和验证者语言
articles.abstractCn: 当语言模型被要求判断其自身答案是否正确时，涉及三种语言：问题的语言、答案请求的语言以及验证指令判断的语言。多语言置信度评估很少区分这三种语言。我们在LSQA、MMMLU和TriviaQA上使用十种开放权重模型（3B-14B）进行六语言因子设计实验，独立变化它们，保持答案在验证语言中固定，并使用首个token的P(True)探针测量置信度。这三种语言在评估中扮演不同角色：哪个语言决定准确性取决于基准，将响应语言与问题或验证语言匹配会提高区分度但不影响校准度，而仅验证语言会改变校准误差高达0.04而不影响准确性。评分者也很重要：一个未经验证的判断者会将MMMLU英语-印地语准确率差距从0.198缩小到0.038。因此，只有当所有三种语言都报告且评分者经过验证时，多语言置信度结果（包括模型排名）才是可比的。

articles.title: SyncPro: Synchronous Reasoning and Responding for Proactive Streaming Video Understanding
articles.abstract: Proactive streaming video understanding requires assistants to track unfolding events and respond when a user's requested condition is met. To make these decisions, assistants must accumulate relevant evidence and reassess response conditions as new observations arrive. Existing work offers complementary capabilities for this process: proactive video assistants learn when to respond, while streaming video reasoning methods generate scheduled intermediate text to organize observations and support subsequent answers. Together, these capabilities provide a foundation for proactive reasoning, but how to coordinate ongoing reasoning with timely responses remains underexplored. In a direct adaptation, fixed reasoning intervals can trigger updates when nothing relevant has changed or postpone useful updates until the next scheduled step. Sharing one generation path also couples two distinct requirements: preserving evidence for future decisions and producing only the response requested by the user. Moreover, responses generated after reasoning must wait for it to finish, even when sufficient evidence is already available. To address these challenges, we introduce SyncPro, a synchronous dual-stream framework with specialized generation paths for evidence tracking and user-facing responses. Its Inner and Response branches share causal history and activate independently, allowing relevant evidence changes to trigger internal updates and responses to proceed concurrently with ongoing reasoning. We construct 189K dual-stream examples and train SyncPro through supervised fine-tuning followed by trajectory-level reinforcement learning. Experiments across three proactive benchmarks show improved response timing and more accurate answers to user requests.
articles.titleCn: SyncPro：同步推理与响应，用于主动流视频理解
articles.abstractCn: 主动式流媒体视频理解需要助手追踪正在发生的事件，并在用户请求的条件满足时做出响应。为了做出这些决策，助手必须积累相关证据，并在新的观察结果出现时重新评估响应条件。现有工作为这一过程提供了互补能力：主动式视频助手学习何时响应，而流媒体视频推理方法生成计划中的中间文本来组织观察结果并支持后续回答。这些能力共同为主动式推理提供了基础，但如何协调持续的推理与及时响应仍待探索。在直接应用中，固定的推理间隔会在无关紧要的情况下触发更新，或推迟有用的更新直至下一个计划步骤。共享一个生成路径将两种不同需求耦合起来：保留证据以供未来决策，以及仅生成用户请求的响应。此外，推理生成的响应必须等待推理完成，即使已有足够的证据。为解决这些挑战，我们引入SyncPro，这是一个同步双流框架，具有专门用于证据追踪和面向用户的响应的生成路径。其内部和响应分支共享因果历史，可独立激活，允许相关证据变化触发内部更新，并使响应能与持续进行的推理同步进行。我们构建了189K双流示例，并通过监督微调后进行轨迹级强化学习来训练SyncPro。在三个主动式基准测试中的实验表明，SyncPro在响应时机和用户请求的答案准确性方面均有提升。

articles.title: Shorter Is Not Cheaper: A Controlled Comparison of Declarative Animation Specifications and Free-Form Code for LLM-Generated Explanations
articles.abstract: Chat assistants increasingly answer conceptual questions with interactive, animated explanations, generated either as free-form HTML/JavaScript or as declarative specifications that a fixed runtime plays. The declarative route is widely expected to be cheaper, faster and more reliable, because its outputs are shorter and constrained. We test this expectation in controlled comparisons whose hypotheses and analysis plans were frozen before the runs. We designed ExplainSpec, a time-indexed declarative animation format, and an observation contract that makes every generated explanation programmatically inspectable; validated, pacing-agnostic checkers score 20 explanation requests from five domains. Three Claude models (360 jobs) and, in a follow-up, the open-weight Qwen3-14B with thinking enabled and disabled (240 jobs) answered every request in both formats. For every model the specifications were 25-48% shorter in answer tokens (output excluding reasoning), yet with reasoning enabled total output fell significantly only for the largest Claude model and no model generated significantly faster. The reasons differed. The Claude models reasoned far more before writing specifications (exploratory; for the two larger models, from 15-20% to 85-88% of generations). Qwen3-14B reasoned about as much in both formats (a pre-registered test of this shift was not supported), and its shorter answers saved little against a reasoning trace more than twice as long. Nor were specifications more reliable: free-form pages were valid after one repair round in 95-100% of jobs for every model, whereas Qwen3-14B produced valid specifications in only 33% of jobs and passed all semantic tests in 17% (HTML/JavaScript: 62%). For reasoning models, a shorter format alone therefore does not make generation cheaper, faster or more reliable, and a format learned in context can cost reliability.
articles.titleCn: 更短并非更便宜：对声明式动画规范与自由形式代码在LLM生成解释中的控制比较
articles.abstractCn: 聊天助手越来越多地通过交互式、动画化的解释来回答概念性问题，这些解释要么以自由形式的HTML/JavaScript生成，要么作为固定运行时执行的声明式规范生成。人们普遍预期声明式方法将更便宜、更快、更可靠，因为其输出更短且受约束。我们在运行前冻结了假设和分析计划的控制比较中测试了这一预期。我们设计了ExplainSpec，一种时间索引的声明式动画格式，以及一个观察合同，使每个生成的解释都可以程序化地检查；经过验证、与节奏无关的检查器对来自五个领域的20个解释请求进行了评分。三种Claude模型（360个任务）以及在后续实验中启用了思考和禁用了思考的开权重的Qwen3-14B（240个任务）以两种格式回答了每个请求。对于每个模型，规范在回答token（不包括推理）中短了25-48%，但在启用推理的情况下，只有最大的Claude模型的输出显著减少，且没有模型显著更快。原因各不相同。Claude模型在编写规范之前进行了大量推理（探索性；对于两个较大的模型，从15-20%到85-88%的生成）。Qwen3-14B在两种格式中的推理程度大致相同（这项转变的预先注册测试没有得到支持），其较短的答案在推理跟踪超过两倍长的情况下节省不多。规范也不更可靠：自由形式的页面在95-100%的任务中经过一次修复轮后对每个模型都有效，而Qwen3-14B只在33%的任务中生成有效的规范，并在17%的任务中通过所有语义测试（HTML/JavaScript：62%）。因此，对于推理模型来说，仅缩短格式并不能使生成更便宜、更快或更可靠，而在上下文中学习的格式可能会牺牲可靠性。

articles.title: From Noisy Retrieval to Decision Evidence: Silver Evidence Demonstrations for In-Context Learning
articles.abstract: RAG and retrieval-augmented few-shot ICL can struggle when decision-relevant evidence is buried in long, noisy context. Retrieved passages and demonstrations may contain redundant or distracting information. Although expert-labeled development examples may identify the text supporting each decision, these annotations are typically used only as answer-side rationales rather than as supervision for filtering noisy retrieval. We propose silver-evidence demonstrations, which replace raw retrieved passages in ICL examples with generated, target-conditioned evidence summaries. For each labeled development example, an LLM generates silver evidence without access to the expert label or gold evidence; this evidence is then paired with the expert label and gold evidence where available. At test time, a single structured call generates silver evidence from retrieved passages and then predicts the final label and decision evidence. Across EI 2.0, SciFact, synthetic policy retrieval, and HICRIC/IMR data, our full method improves over equally sized gold-only ICL (label-only for policy) on three of four datasets and improves evidence F1 on all annotated datasets. It also achieves higher mean label accuracy than InstructRAG-style ICL on all four datasets. These results suggest that replacing demonstration-side retrieved passages with compact, target-conditioned silver evidence is particularly useful for decisions based on long and noisy text, where it reduces distracting context while preserving decision-relevant signals and expert supervision.
articles.titleCn: 从噪声检索到决策证据：银色证据演示用于情境内学习
articles.abstractCn: 当决策相关证据隐藏在冗长且嘈杂的上下文中时，RAG 和检索增强式少样本 ICL 方法可能会遇到困难。检索到的段落和示例可能包含冗余或分散注意力的信息。尽管专家标注的开发示例可以识别支持每个决策的文本，但这些标注通常仅用作答案侧的推理依据，而不是用于过滤嘈杂检索的监督信息。我们提出了银质证据示例，它用生成的、目标条件化的证据摘要替换 ICL 示例中的原始检索段落。对于每个标注的开发示例，大型语言模型在不访问专家标签或金质证据的情况下生成银质证据；然后，在可用的情况下，将此证据与专家标签和金质证据配对。在测试时，单个结构化调用从检索段落生成银质证据，然后预测最终标签和决策证据。在 EI 2.0、SciFact、合成政策检索以及 HICRIC/IMR 数据集上，我们的完整方法在四个数据集中的三个上优于同等规模的仅金质 ICL（政策为仅标签），并在所有标注数据集上提高了证据 F1 分数。它还在所有四个数据集上比 InstructRAG 风格的 ICL 实现了更高的平均标签准确率。这些结果表明，用紧凑、目标条件化的银质证据替换示例侧的检索段落，对于基于长篇嘈杂文本的决策特别有用，因为它减少了分散注意力的上下文，同时保留了决策相关信号和专家监督。

articles.title: Data Quality in RVL-CDIP: A Systematic Audit
articles.abstract: RVL-CDIP is the de facto standard benchmark for document classification, and reported accuracy on it is now 98.8%. In this paper, we audit RVL-CDIP for data quality issues and find that approximately 10.5% of its 400,000 documents have erroneous labels and that 35.2% of the test set has a duplicate or near-duplicate in the training set. Identification codes on the pages are sufficient to classify at 69% accuracy, and a state-of-the-art model loses 11 points without them. Image-only models trained on RVL-CDIP lose 16 to 28 points on documents from other sources, and the choice of OCR engine changes accuracy by 4.1 to 8.3 points. We find that nearly 16,000 RVL-CDIP documents contain sensitive personal data, and produce de-identified versions of these documents. We re-benchmark 25 models, and with all defects remediated, the 13 that we retrain are 0.9 to 2.9 points more accurate than in the original condition; the most accurate of them, LayoutLMv3, is 96.5% accurate. We release the corrected corpus, the annotations and the out-of-distribution data.
articles.titleCn: RVL-CDIP数据质量：系统审计
articles.abstractCn: RVL-CDIP是目前文档分类领域的实际标准基准，其上报告的准确率现已达到98.8%。在本文中，我们对RVL-CDIP的数据质量问题进行了审计，发现其40万份文档中约有10.5%存在错误标签，且测试集中有35.2%的文档在训练集中存在重复或近似重复。页面上的识别码足以实现69%的分类准确率，而最先进的模型在没有这些识别码的情况下会损失11个百分点。仅在RVL-CDIP上训练的图像模型在其他来源的文档上会损失16至28个百分点，而OCR引擎的选择会改变4.1至8.3个百分点的准确率。我们发现近16000份RVL-CDIP文档包含敏感个人信息，并生成了这些文档的匿名化版本。我们对25个模型重新进行了基准测试，在所有缺陷都得到修复后，重新训练的13个模型比原始状态下的准确率提高了0.9至2.9个百分点；其中最准确的模型LayoutLMv3达到了96.5%的准确率。我们发布了修正后的语料库、标注和分布外数据。

articles.title: Semantically Rich, Metrically Affect-Blind: A Geometric Blind Spot in Modern Text Embedders
articles.abstract: We report a systematic dissociation in modern text embedders: sentiment is almost perfectly decodable from their embeddings, yet almost entirely absent from their metric. Across eleven frozen encoders spanning 2021 to 2026, including 2026-generation models and the 4B-parameter LLM embedder Qwen3-Embedding-4B, a linear probe recovers sentence polarity at up to 91.3% accuracy while cosine similarity separates polarity by a margin of only 0.003-0.064. Qwen3-Embedding-4B, the strongest probe in the panel, reaches 91.3% probe accuracy but only 64.3 retrieval MAP. Because retrieval, clustering, deduplication, and retrieval-augmented generation operate on the metric rather than on a trained probe, these systems are effectively blind to information their encoder demonstrably contains. A task-conditioning control suggests this reflects the pretraining objective rather than a prompting artifact: conditioning Jina-v5 on its classification task rather than its retrieval task recovers only about half of the MAP gain that injection achieves on the same weights (63.2 to 73.8, versus 85.1), and leaves the alignment gap essentially unchanged.
