Sentiment-Injected Sentence Embeddings (SISE) train a small (0.13M-0.69M-parameter) supervised-contrastive head on a frozen encoder in seconds on a CPU, using the labelled training set. The head improves every encoder released since 2022 on full-data probe accuracy (up to +5.8 points), retrieval MAP (up to +26.0) and polarity margin (7-61x). This is a specialization, not a free gain: the compact 128-d head loses 38-41 Spearman points on STS-B, while a fused variant that concatenates it with the base embedding loses 2.4-12.0. With the head, a 0.6B encoder at 128 dimensions matches a 4B encoder given the same head (91.8 vs. 90.3 MAP). We release a CPU-reproducible pipeline and a reusable diagnostic, the Attribute Alignment Gap.
articles.titleCn: 语义丰富，度量上情感盲点：现代文本嵌入器中的几何盲区
articles.abstractCn: 我们报告了现代文本嵌入器中存在的一种系统性问题：情感几乎可以从其嵌入中完美解码，但在其度量中几乎完全缺失。在涵盖2021年至2026年的11个冻结编码器中，包括2026代模型和参数为4B的LLM嵌入器Qwen3-Embedding-4B，线性探针能够以高达91.3%的准确率恢复句子极性，而余弦相似度在极性区分上的差距仅为0.003-0.064。Qwen3-Embedding-4B作为该系列中最强的探针，达到了91.3%的探针准确率，但只有64.3的检索MAP。由于检索、聚类、去重和检索增强生成等操作基于度量而非训练探针，这些系统实际上对其编码器明确包含的信息是盲目的。任务条件控制表明，这反映了预训练目标而非提示伪影：将Jina-v5在其分类任务而非检索任务上进行条件化，仅恢复了注入权重时约一半的MAP增益（63.2到73.8，对比85.1），且对对齐差距基本没有改变。情感注入句子嵌入（SISE）在CPU上仅需几秒钟，即可在冻结编码器上训练一个小的（0.13M-0.69M参数）监督对比头，使用标记的训练集。该头提高了自2022年以来发布的每个编码器的全数据探针准确率（最高+5.8分）、检索MAP（最高+26.0）和极性差距（7-61倍）。这是一种专业化，而非免费增益：紧凑的128-d头在STS-B上损失了38-41个Spearman分，而一个将其与基础嵌入连接的融合变体则损失了2.4-12.0。配备该头时，一个0.6B的128维编码器在相同头的情况下可与4B编码器匹敌（91.8 vs. 90.3 MAP）。我们发布了一个CPU可复现的流程和一个可复用的诊断工具，即属性对齐差距。

articles.title: EDWARD-NMT: Elastic Dimensions With Adaptive Routing and Dual-consistency for Neural Machine Translation
articles.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is a powerful paradigm for scaling Neural Machine Translation (NMT) and managing language heterogeneity. However, practical limitations hinder its deployment on resource-constrained devices: the entire expert pool must remain in memory, and the per-token compute budget is statically fixed during training by rigid top-k routing. We introduce EDWARD-NMT (Elastic Dimensions With Adaptive Routing and Dual-consistency for NMT), a novel MoE encoder-decoder architecture designed for a train once, deploy anywhere paradigm that exposes a family of deployable sub-networks at inference time. EDWARD-NMT integrates three key innovations: (i) Matryoshka-style elastic dimensions to flexibly reduce the memory footprint; (ii) an adaptive sigmoid router with a learned, task-conditioned threshold, allowing each token to dynamically determine its active expert count; and (iii) a dual-consistency objective to maximize the performance of the extracted sub-networks. Extensive experiments on PhoMT (En-Vi), WMT-14 (En-De), multilingual OPUS-16, and a multi-domain De-En benchmark validate our approach. The full-capacity architecture matches or exceeds strong MoE baselines with improved parameter efficiency. Furthermore, the sub-networks seamlessly extracted from a single checkpoint consistently outperform comparably sized dense Transformers without any retraining.
articles.titleCn: EDWARD-NMT：具有自适应路由和双重一致性的弹性维度神经机器翻译
articles.abstractCn: 稀疏专家混合（MoE）是一种强大的范式，用于扩展神经机器翻译（NMT）并管理语言异质性。然而，实际限制阻碍了其在资源受限设备上的部署：整个专家池必须保留在内存中，并且每个token的计算预算在训练期间由刚性的top-k路由静态固定。我们引入了EDWARD-NMT（具有自适应路由和双重一致性功能的弹性维度NMT），这是一种新颖的MoE编码器-解码器架构，专为“一次训练，随处部署”范式设计，在推理时暴露一系列可部署的子网络。EDWARD-NMT集成了三项关键创新：(i) 俄罗斯套娃式弹性维度，以灵活地减少内存占用；(ii) 具有学习型任务条件阈值的自适应Sigmoid路由器，允许每个token动态确定其激活专家数量；(iii) 双重一致性目标，以最大化提取的子网络性能。在PhoMT（英-越）、WMT-14（英-德）、多语言OPUS-16以及多领域德-英基准上的大量实验验证了我们的方法。全容量架构在参数效率方面与或超过了强大的MoE基线。此外，从单个检查点无缝提取的子网络始终优于同等规模的密集Transformer，且无需任何再训练。

articles.title: Tampered ML: Evaluating LLM Judgment of Machine Learning Research
articles.abstract: One approach to accelerating progress on AI alignment is to automate parts of alignment research itself. Doing so requires systems that can perform reliably on hard-to-supervise research tasks, including identifying flaws in research proposals and evaluating whether a proposed experiment supports its intended claim. To evaluate this capability, we introduce Tampered ML, a benchmark of 1,858 item-pairs, each consisting of an experiment proposal reconstructed from a published machine learning paper and a minimally edited counterfactual that introduces a targeted methodological flaw. Models must identify the more methodologically sound proposal in both presentation orders. A human validation study on a stratified sample estimates that 86% of items are valid (95% CI: 81-91%). Frontier models perform above chance but remain far from reliable (with Opus 5 achieving 77.9% accuracy). They are highly sensitive to the order of presentation and favor flawed designs that appear more specific, transparent, or conventional.
articles.comment: 28 pages, 10 figures. Accepted at EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference)
articles.titleCn: 篡改机器学习：评估大型语言模型对机器学习研究的判断
articles.abstractCn: 一种加速人工智能对齐研究进展的方法是自动化对齐研究的一部分。这样做需要能够在难以监督的研究任务上可靠运行的系统，包括识别研究提案中的缺陷，以及评估所提出的实验是否支持其预期声明。为了评估这种能力，我们引入了Tampered ML，这是一个包含1,858个项目对的基准，每个项目对由一个从已发表的机器学习论文中重建的实验提案和一个引入目标方法缺陷的最小编辑反事实组成。模型必须在两种呈现顺序中都识别出方法上更合理的设计。对分层样本进行的人类验证研究表明，86%的项目是有效的（95%置信区间：81-91%）。前沿模型的表现优于随机猜测，但仍远未达到可靠水平（Opus 5达到了77.9%的准确率）。它们对呈现顺序非常敏感，并倾向于选择看起来更具体、更透明或更传统的缺陷设计。

articles.title: REACT: Representational Early Analysis and Control of Chain-of-Thought Trajectories
articles.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) generation offers an opportunity to intervene before a reasoning model completes its answer. But does the point at which risk is easiest to detect also offer the most effective control? We study this question with REACT, a conditional activation intervention that learns a safety direction from paired safe and unsafe trajectories and applies it once to an early CoT hidden state. The model weights remain frozen, and all subsequent tokens are generated without further edits. To study timing, we train directions separately at each of the first five CoT positions and evaluate ungated edits with full post-edit regeneration. Across three distilled reasoning models and three generation seeds, the strongest gains concentrate in a two- to three-token early window; on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B, the effect falls to approximately zero at the fourth and fifth tokens, even though later states can be more predictive of risk. This separates risk readability from effective control: intervention timing must be evaluated through its effect on subsequent generation. On the same 8B model, REACT raises the rate of fully safe CoT-answer outputs on StrongREJECT-273 from 29.06% to 82.05%, while keeping benign refusal and usefulness near baseline. An anonymized implementation is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/REACT_official2-333B.
articles.titleCn: REACT：思维链轨迹的表征性早期分析与控制
articles.abstractCn: 思维链（CoT）生成提供了在推理模型完成答案前进行干预的机会。但风险最容易检测的点是否也是最有效的控制点？我们通过REACT研究这个问题，REACT是一种条件激活干预方法，它从成对的安全和危险轨迹中学习安全方向，并将其一次性应用于早期的CoT隐藏状态。模型权重保持冻结，后续所有标记均在不进行进一步编辑的情况下生成。为了研究时机，我们在前五个CoT位置分别训练方向，并评估无门控编辑后的完整后编辑再生效果。在三个蒸馏推理模型和三个生成种子中，最大的增益集中在早期两到三个标记的窗口内；在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B上，效果在第四个和第五个标记时降至接近零，尽管后续状态可能更能预测风险。这区分了风险可读性与有效控制：干预时机必须通过其对后续生成的影响来评估。在相同的8B模型上，REACT将StrongREJECT-273上完全安全的CoT答案输出率从29.06%提高到82.05%，同时将良性拒绝和有用性保持在基线附近。匿名化实现可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/REACT_official2-333B获取。

articles.title: Context or Knowledge: How LLMs Attribute Their Own Answers
articles.abstract: Language models can answer a question from a supplied document or from their parametric knowledge. When later asked where the answer came from, what determines their source report? We study this by intervening on the model's key-value (KV) cache after the answer is generated and before the source question is asked. On a controlled factual task with four models (7B-32B), changing or removing the document's cache never changes the report. In contrast, transplanting the question-and-answer (Q+A) cache between runs with identical question and answer tokens transfers it: every eligible report follows the donor, while the recipient's document is unchanged. On the two smaller models, steering Q+A values along directions fitted before any source question reverses 98.9-100% of reports across four document conditions at a fixed strength, while norm-matched random directions flip at most 1.1%. The components of keys and values along fitted directions carry the transplant effect: copying them alone nearly reproduces the report change; holding them fixed nearly prevents it. Applied during answer generation, the same value directions also change which source supplies the answer, though more weakly and depending on the prompt. Source reporting in this setting thus depends causally on cached state produced while answering. We do not establish general reporting accuracy or a complete interpretation of this state.
articles.titleCn: 背景或知识：大型语言模型如何为其答案进行归因
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型可以从提供的文档或其参数化知识中回答问题。当后来被问及答案来源时，决定其来源报告的是什么？我们通过在生成答案后、提问来源问题前干预模型的键值（KV）缓存来研究这一点。在一个有四个模型（7B-32B）的控制性事实任务中，改变或移除文档的缓存从未改变报告。相比之下，在具有相同问题和答案标记的运行之间移植问答（Q+A）缓存会转移它：每个符合条件的报告都跟随捐赠者，而接受者的文档保持不变。在两个较小的模型上，沿着在提出任何来源问题之前拟合的方向引导Q+A值，在四个文档条件下以固定强度逆转98.9-100%的报告，而归一化随机方向最多翻转1.1%。键和值沿拟合方向携带移植效应：仅复制它们几乎可以重现报告变化；将它们固定几乎可以防止这种变化。在生成答案时，相同的值方向也会改变提供答案的来源，尽管更弱，并且取决于提示。在这种设置下，来源报告因此取决于在回答时产生的缓存状态。我们没有建立一般的报告准确性或对该状态的完整解释。

articles.title: Beyond What to Say: Proactive Utterance Timing with Inner Thoughts for Werewolf Agents
articles.abstract: Participating in a conversation involves not only deciding what to say but also whether to speak at all. This judgment carries even greater significance in environments like the Werewolf game, where participants' interests conflict, because both utterances and silence are subject to interpretation and assessment by others. Therefore, determining when to speak, as well as what to say, is crucial for an LLM agent playing the Werewolf game. In this study, we introduce a Werewolf AI agent developed for the Anytime Utterance Track of the AIWolfDial shared task. Our system builds on the existing Inner Thoughts framework, which determines utterance timing during conversations by generating internal thoughts and evaluating the value of each thought for expression at that moment. Since existing methods were designed for general dialogue, we have redesigned the system specifically for the competitive environment and incomplete information setting of Werewolf games. We call our adapted method Adversarial Inner Thoughts. Through experiments involving analysis of self-play logs and human evaluations, we analyze and discuss the effectiveness of our approach.
articles.comment: Accepted to the 4th International AIWolfDial Workshop at INLG 2026
articles.titleCn: 超越言语之外：狼人代理的主动话语时机与内心思考
articles.abstractCn: 参与对话不仅涉及决定说什么，还涉及是否应该发言。这种判断在狼人杀游戏等参与者利益冲突的环境中具有更大的意义，因为发言和沉默都会受到他人的解读和评估。因此，对于参与狼人杀游戏的LLM代理来说，确定何时发言以及说什么至关重要。在本研究中，我们介绍了一个为AIWolfDial共享任务的Anytime Utterance Track开发的狼人杀AI代理。我们的系统基于现有的Inner Thoughts框架，该框架通过生成内部想法并评估每个想法在当前时刻表达的值来确定对话中的发言时机。由于现有方法是为通用对话设计的，我们专门针对狼人杀游戏的竞争环境和信息不完整设置重新设计了该系统。我们称这种方法为对抗性Inner Thoughts。通过分析自我博弈日志和人工评估的实验，我们分析和讨论了我们的方法的有效性。

articles.title: Putting Transformer Theories to the Test
articles.abstract: Several formal theories have been developed to characterize the capabilities and limitations of the transformer architecture, each employing different abstractions that capture different features of the architecture. Due to the differences in their underlying assumptions and conceptual frameworks, these theories can disagree in their predictions about what tasks transformers find easy or hard. We map out seven theories of transformer capability (Star-free, $\mathsf{AC}^0$, $\mathsf{TC}^0$, C-RASP, MPC, BAPO, and Sensitivity) and translate their results into a common matrix of predictions across a suite of tasks covering different computational structures. We provide new theoretical results to complete this matrix. We then evaluate theoretical predictions through controlled experiments measuring in-distribution sample complexity, length generalization, and pretrained language model performance. We find that no single theory explains the observed pattern of successes and failures. When a theory does not capture the transformer behaviors relevant to a task, its predictions break down; for instance, we show that the $k$-hop induction task is predicted hard by C-RASP because it does not model content-dependent attention, but we train small transformers on this task that length-generalize. Similarly, theories assuming hard attention like $\mathsf{AC}^0$ and BAPO predict binary majority to be hard, for which we also find success in practice. Together, our results point to several specific features that a theory of transformers must capture: soft rather than hard attention, dynamic content-dependent retrieval, bounded computation at each position, an account of learnability and inductive biases, and a combination of upper and lower bounds.
articles.titleCn: 测试Transformer理论
articles.abstractCn: 已经发展出几种形式化理论来描述Transformer架构的能力和局限性，每种理论都采用不同的抽象方法来捕捉架构的不同特征。由于它们在基本假设和概念框架上的差异，这些理论在预测Transformer在哪些任务上容易或困难时可能会存在分歧。我们梳理了七种Transformer能力理论（Star-free、$\mathsf{AC}^0$、$\mathsf{TC}^0$、C-RASP、MPC、BAPO和Sensitivity），并将它们的结果翻译成一个涵盖不同计算结构的任务集合的预测矩阵。我们提供了新的理论结果来完善这个矩阵。然后，我们通过控制实验评估理论预测，测量分布内样本复杂度、长度泛化以及预训练语言模型的性能。我们发现没有单一理论能够解释观察到的成功与失败的模式。当理论未能捕捉到与任务相关的Transformer行为时，其预测就会失效；例如，我们展示了C-RASP预测$k$-hop归纳任务困难，因为它没有模拟内容相关的注意力，但我们在这个任务上训练的小型Transformer能够实现长度泛化。类似地，假设注意力困难的$\mathsf{AC}^0$和BAPO理论预测二进制多数投票困难，我们在实践中也发现了成功案例。综合我们的结果，指向了Transformer理论必须捕捉的几个具体特征：软注意力而非硬注意力、动态内容相关检索、每个位置的有限计算、可学习性和归纳偏置的解释，以及上下界的结合。

articles.title: Behaviour analysis for large language model-driven agents
articles.abstract: Understanding language-agent behaviour requires learning how actions are organised across a trajectory and how this organisation relates to context and outcomes. We propose a general framework that connects data-driven behavioural discovery with analysis and experimental investigation. Categories developed from recorded activity define what is measured. Analyses preserve the behaviours' positions in the process and express their relationships as interpretable hypotheses. Statistical assessment and tests in held-out contexts examine the strength and scope of the evidence. Experiments, including prompt steering, then test how behaviour and outcomes change under deliberately varied conditions. A study of iterative self-reflection illustrates how discovery, dependency learning and prompt comparisons can inform one another. We develop this approach for trajectories of varying length, event order and agent roles, and identify advances in coding, analysis and experimentation needed to support its wider use.
articles.comment: Under review by Nature Machine Intelligence
articles.titleCn: 基于大型语言模型的智能体行为分析
articles.abstractCn: 理解语言代理的行为需要学习如何在轨迹中组织行为以及这种组织如何与上下文和结果相关。我们提出一个通用框架，将数据驱动的行为发现与分析及实验研究相结合。从记录的活动中开发的类别定义了测量的内容。分析保留了行为在过程中的位置，并以可解释的假设表达它们之间的关系。统计评估和保留在特定上下文中的测试检验证据的强度和范围。实验（包括提示引导）则测试在故意变化条件下行为和结果如何变化。一项关于迭代自我反思的研究说明了发现、依赖学习和提示比较如何相互启发。我们针对不同长度、事件顺序和代理角色的轨迹开发此方法，并确定了在编码、分析和实验方面需要改进的地方以支持其更广泛的应用。

articles.title: Concentrated Causal Influence, Distributed Diagnostic Information: Cognitive Impairment Decisions in Large Audio-Language Models
articles.abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) can assess cognitive impairment (CI) from speech, yet their answers reveal neither which internal components control the decision nor how much CI information is accessible in their representations. We investigate both questions through CI-contrast neurons (CICNs), selected by class-contrastive activation frequency in decoder MLPs. Across eight open LALMs and two corpora (Pitt and PROCESS-2), we causally test CICNs against size- and layer-matched random masks and activity-matched controls. In three of the five models that meet our eligibility criteria, ablation of small CICN sets causes large, class-directed prediction shifts; speech-identified masks also control transcript-only decisions, and three of four primary Pitt masks retain specificity on PROCESS-2. Position-restricted interventions locate the influence before the final answer position, most strongly after the speech or transcript evidence under letter-labeled options, largely as a decision-direction shift. Beyond causal localization, supervised linear readouts of frozen CICN activations achieve 0.92--0.97 AUC within Pitt, versus 0.67--0.84 for the models' direct answers. Matched random and all-neuron readouts reach comparable performance; top-ranked CICNs show only an exploratory advantage at very small unit budgets. These results distinguish concentrated causal control over output decisions from broadly distributed diagnostic information for CI detection in LALMs.
articles.titleCn: 聚焦因果影响，分布式诊断信息：大型音语言模型中的认知障碍决策
articles.abstractCn: 大型语音语言模型（LALMs）能够通过语音评估认知障碍（CI），但它们的回答既没有揭示控制决策的内部组件，也没有说明多少CI信息在其表征中是可访问的。我们通过CI对比神经元（CICNs）来研究这两个问题，这些CICNs是根据解码器MLP中的类对比激活频率选择的。在八个开源LALMs和两个语料库（Pitt和PROCESS-2）中，我们通过因果测试CICNs与大小和层匹配的随机掩码以及活动匹配的对照。在符合我们资格标准的五个模型中的三个模型中，移除小规模的CICN集会导致大型的、类导向的预测变化；语音识别的掩码也控制着仅转录的决策，并且四个Pitt主要掩码中的三个在PROCESS-2上保持了特异性。位置限制的干预定位了影响在最终答案位置之前的位置，在字母标记选项下，最强烈地出现在语音或转录证据之后，主要是作为决策方向的转变。除了因果定位之外，对冻结的CICN激活的监督线性读出在Pitt中实现了0.92--0.97的AUC，而模型的直接回答仅为0.67--0.84。匹配的随机和所有神经元读出达到了相当的性能；排名靠前的CICN在极小的单元预算下仅显示出探索性的优势。这些结果区分了LALMs中输出决策的集中因果控制与广泛分布的CI检测诊断信息。

articles.title: How Much Do You Trust A Dog? Quantifying Hint-Following in Reasoning Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often exhibit sycophancy, altering their answers to align with user suggestions even on objective factual and reasoning tasks. Yet the quantitative form of this influence--- and whether it is calibrated to source reliability--- remains poorly understood. In this work, we investigate this behavior through hint-induced answer shifts on MMLU questions, evaluating prompts of the form ``[Source] thinks the answer is (X)''. We systematically vary the source to which the hint is attributed (a professor, a friend, or a dog) across three open-source model families, Qwen, Gemma, and SmolLM. We show that the change induced by the hint follows a predictable structure well-characterized by an exponential tilt: the hint induces an approximately constant mean shift in the hinted answer's log-odds, with question--target susceptibility largely shared across sources. To explore how this pattern can arise, we introduce a formal decomposition of the hint response and illustrate in controlled synthetic experiments how KL-regularized reward-based training reshapes both hinted and unhinted answer distributions. Finally, we evaluate whether this shift is calibrated to source reliability, finding that the log-odds shift persists even when the hint-giver is declared inaccurate or accompanied by explicit warnings not to trust the source, highlighting the vulnerability of LLMs to adversarial steering.
articles.titleCn: 你有多信任一只狗？量化推理语言模型中的提示遵循能力
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）常常表现出谄媚行为，在客观事实和推理任务中也会改变答案以迎合用户建议。然而，这种影响的影响程度——以及它是否与信息来源的可靠性相匹配——仍然知之甚少。在这项工作中，我们通过MMLU问题上的提示诱导答案变化来研究这种行为，评估形式为“[来源]认为答案是(X)”的提示。我们系统地改变了提示所归属的来源（教授、朋友或狗），涵盖了Qwen、Gemma和SmolLM三个开源模型系列。我们发现，提示引起的变化遵循一个可预测的结构，可以用指数倾斜很好地描述：提示导致被提示答案的对数概率近似恒定变化，而问题—目标敏感性在很大程度上在不同来源之间是共享的。为了探索这种模式如何产生，我们引入了提示响应的正式分解，并通过受控的合成实验说明了KL正则化奖励训练如何重塑被提示和未被提示答案的分布。最后，我们评估这种变化是否与来源可靠性相匹配，发现即使提示者被声明不准确或伴随着不信任该来源的明确警告，对数概率变化仍然存在，突显了LLMs容易受到对抗性引导的脆弱性。

articles.title: X-Dubbing: Speech-to-Speech Translation under Temporal and Visual Constraints
articles.abstract: Cross-lingual dubbing aims to convert source speech into target-language speech that remains synchronized with the original video. The key to this task is to produce a faithful translation that is naturally speakable within the source timing, which is non-trivial because languages differ in duration, rhythm, and articulation. In this paper, we propose X-Dubbing, which formulates the task as a joint problem of time-aware speech-to-text translation and video-aware text-to-speech. Specifically, our method consists of a Dubbing Translator that generates temporally structured scripts and a Voice Actor that renders them in synchrony with the source video, both grounded in a language-agnostic timing budget. We further refine the translator with dubbing-aware feedback from the synthesized speech, encouraging scripts that yield well-synchronized dubbing. This design requires no paired dubbing data, as the two components are trained on speech-text and monolingual audio-visual data respectively. Extensive experiments show that X-Dubbing outperforms recent baselines across diverse metrics, including isochrony and audio-visual correspondence.
articles.titleCn: X-配音：在时序和视觉约束下的语音到语音翻译
articles.abstractCn: 跨语言配音旨在将源语音转换为与原始视频同步的目标语言语音。这项任务的关键在于，在源语音的时间框架内生成忠实且自然可读的翻译，这并不简单，因为不同语言在时长、韵律和发音上存在差异。在本文中，我们提出了X-Dubbing方法，将任务表述为一个结合时间感知语音到文本翻译和视频感知文本到语音的联合问题。具体而言，我们的方法包含一个配音翻译器，用于生成时间结构的剧本，以及一个配音演员，使其与源视频同步进行演绎，两者都基于语言无关的时间预算。我们进一步通过合成的语音提供配音感知的反馈来改进翻译器，鼓励生成与配音良好同步的剧本。该设计无需配对的配音数据，因为两个组件分别基于语音文本和单语视听数据进行训练。大量实验表明，X-Dubbing在多种指标上，包括等时性和视听对应性方面，均优于最近的基础模型。

articles.title: CRM-Agent-Bench: Benchmarking Tool-Using Agents in Stateful Enterprise Environments
articles.abstract: Deploying language agents in real applications demands more than the right answer: an agent must execute a multi-step business process correctly, follow domain-specific rules, and interact with a user across a dialogue, where the gap between saying and doing is the gap between a satisfied customer and a real loss. We argue that a deployable-agent benchmark should jointly assess four facets: the outcome an agent reaches, the trajectory it takes, its operational viability, and its policy compliance. Customer relationship management (CRM), where mutable records meet operational rules and consequential effects, exercises all four. We introduce CRM-Agent-Bench, an execution-grounded benchmark of 555 stateful, multi-turn tasks across nine business domains and 36 capability tags. Each task supplies a task-specific executable contract drawn from checks over actions, arguments, order, response, target state, and protected state; success is the strict conjunction of the checks declared for that task. We evaluate the complete agent system through these contracts and report scored coverage, latency, and cost. Across sixteen systems evaluated on the audited final release, strict success spans 64.32% to 83.60%; the closely grouped leading systems nonetheless diverge sharply in cost and per-domain reliability. CRM-Agent-Bench offers an auditable framework for measuring contract-grounded business-transaction integrity and adherence to task-declared benchmark policies, with a portable structure designed for extension as models improve. Github repository: https://github.com/salesforce-misc/crm-agent-bench
articles.titleCn: CRM-Agent-Bench：面向有状态企业环境的工具使用代理基准测试工具
articles.abstractCn: 在真实应用中部署语言代理不仅需要提供正确答案，还要求代理能够正确执行多步骤业务流程、遵循特定领域规则，并在对话中与用户进行交互，其中说与做的差距就是满意客户与实际损失的差距。我们认为，可部署代理基准应综合评估四个方面：代理达成的结果、其执行轨迹、其运营可行性以及其策略合规性。客户关系管理（CRM）领域，其中可变记录与运营规则及后果相互作用，能够全面考验这四个方面。我们介绍了CRM-Agent-Bench，这是一个基于执行的基准，包含555个状态性、多轮任务，涵盖九个业务领域和36个能力标签。每个任务提供特定于任务的执行合同，该合同基于对动作、参数、顺序、响应、目标状态和受保护状态的检查；成功是任务声明的检查条件的严格合取。我们通过这些合同评估完整代理系统的表现，并报告评分覆盖率、延迟和成本。在审计后的最终版本上评估的十六个系统中，严格成功率范围在64.32%到83.60%；尽管领先系统紧密聚集，但在成本和各领域可靠性上却存在显著差异。CRM-Agent-Bench提供了一个可审计框架，用于衡量基于合同的业务交易完整性和对任务声明基准策略的遵守，其结构设计便于随着模型改进而扩展。Github仓库：https://github.com/salesforce-misc/crm-agent-bench
